E_text: A dispatch board shows 18 parcels awaiting pickup and 7 already on vehicles. Its target is 31 parcels in these two states combined. How many further parcels must enter either state to meet the target?
R_text: Ravaangi ke pat par 18 gathriyan uthane ke intezaar mein aur 7 gaadiyon par hain. In dono sthitiyon mein kul 31 gathriyan honi chahiye. Lakshya tak pahunchne ke liye inmein kitni aur gathriyan aani chahiye?
C_text: Ravaangi ke pat par 18 gathriyan intezaar mein aur 7 gaadiyon par hain. The combined target for these states is 31 parcels. Lakshya ke liye kitni aur gathriyan chahiye?

E_text: Two bookmarks lie at pages 64 and 81 of a library volume. How many page numbers lie strictly between them?
R_text: Pustakalay ki kitab mein do panna-soochak 64 aur 81 par hain. In dono ko chhodkar inke beech kitne panna-ank hain?
C_text: Pustakalay ki kitab ke do panna-soochak 64 aur 81 par hain. How many page numbers lie strictly between them?

E_text: A phone download needs 850 MB of free space. The phone currently has 620 MB free. Removing one temporary file frees 140 MB. How much additional space must be freed after removing that file?
R_text: Doorbhash par ek sanchika lene ke liye 850 MB khaali sthaan chahiye. Abhi 620 MB khaali hai. Ek asthaayi sanchika mitaane se 140 MB sthaan milega. Use mitaane ke baad aur kitne MB khaali karne honge?
C_text: Doorbhash par sanchika lene ke liye 850 MB chahiye; abhi 620 MB khaali hai. Deleting a temporary file frees 140 MB. Uske baad aur kitne MB khaali karne honge?

E_text: At a two-day wedding, 120 people attend on the first day and 95 on the second. Exactly 160 distinct people attend across both days. How many attend on both days?
R_text: Do din ki shaadi mein pehle din 120 log aur doosre din 95 log aate hain. Dono dinon ko dekhein to 160 alag vyakti aate hain. Kitne log dono din aate hain?
C_text: Shaadi mein pehle din 120 aur doosre din 95 log aate hain; 160 alag vyakti aate hain. How many attend on both days?

E_text: Two hostel dining rooms start with 46 and 30 plates. Staff move 5 plates from the first room to the second. By how many plates does the first room's count now exceed the second's?
R_text: Chhatravaas ke do bhojan kakshon mein 46 aur 30 thaaliyan hain. Pehle se 5 thaaliyan doosre mein pahunchayi jaati hain. Ab pehle kaksh ki sankhya doosre ki sankhya se kitni aage hai?
C_text: Chhatravaas ke kakshon mein 46 aur 30 thaaliyan hain. Five plates move from the first to the second. Ab pehle kaksh ki sankhya doosre se kitni aage hai?

E_text: A wedding organiser pays a decorator INR 1800 as a deposit, representing a one-third share of the full charge. How many rupees must be paid after the deposit?
R_text: Shaadi ka aayojak sajaavat wale ko INR 1800 agrim deta hai. Yeh poore shulk ka ek tihaai hissa hai. Agrim ke baad kitne rupaye dene hain?
C_text: Shaadi ka aayojak INR 1800 agrim deta hai, jo poore shulk ka ek tihaai hissa hai. How many rupees must be paid after the deposit?

E_text: A courier collects INR 1260 from recipients. The courier keeps a fixed INR 60 handling fee plus INR 15 for each of 8 deliveries and remits the rest. How much is remitted?
R_text: Dooth praaptakartaon se INR 1260 leta hai. Ismein se INR 60 ka tay shulk aur 8 gathriyan pahunchane ke liye ek gathri ke INR 15 kaat leta hai. Woh kitne rupaye jama karega?
C_text: Dooth INR 1260 leta hai. The courier keeps INR 60 plus INR 15 for each of 8 deliveries. Kitne rupaye jama karega?

E_text: A clinic sells appointment booklets containing 6 visits for INR 450. Individual visits cost INR 90. How much does one booklet save compared with paying individually for 6 visits?
R_text: Chikitsaalay mein 6 mulaqaton ki pustika INR 450 ki milti hai. Alag mulaqat ka shulk INR 90 hai. 6 mulaqatein alag dene ki tulna mein pustika se kitne rupaye ki bachat hai?
C_text: Chikitsaalay mein 6 mulaqaton ki pustika INR 450 ki hai; alag mulaqat INR 90 ki. How much does the booklet save against paying individually for 6 visits?

E_text: A hostel collects INR 50 for each of 18 reusable bowls. Suppliers refund INR 35 for each bowl returned intact. Exactly 16 are returned intact. What is the net bowl expense?
R_text: Chhatravaas 18 dobara istemaal hone wale katoron ke liye ek katore ke INR 50 deta hai. Sahi-salaamat lautaaye katore ke INR 35 milte hain. 16 katore sahi-salaamat lautaye gaye. Katoron par vaastavik kharch kitne rupaye hai?
C_text: Chhatravaas 18 katoron ke liye ek ke INR 50 deta hai. The supplier refunds INR 35 for each intact return; 16 qualify. Katoron par vaastavik kharch kitne rupaye hai?

E_text: A garden watering account has INR 75 of credit. Its new bill is INR 380, and a late fee of INR 20 applies before payment. How much cash clears the account?
R_text: Baag ki sinchaai ke khaate mein INR 75 pehle se jama hain. Naya shulk INR 380 hai aur bhugtaan se pehle INR 20 ka vilamb shulk lagta hai. Khaata chukane ke liye kitne rupaye dene hain?
C_text: Baag ki sinchaai ke khaate mein INR 75 jama hain; naya shulk INR 380 hai. A late fee of INR 20 also applies. Khaata chukane ke liye kitne rupaye dene hain?

E_text: A phone repair shop charges INR 670 before a promotional deduction. The deduction is INR 10 for each complete INR 100 of that charge. What is the final bill?
R_text: Doorbhash ki marammat ka shulk chhoot se pehle INR 670 hai. Us shulk ke INR 100 ke ek poore samooh par INR 10 ki chhoot milti hai. Antim shulk kitne rupaye hai?
C_text: Doorbhash ki marammat chhoot se pehle INR 670 ki hai. The discount is INR 10 per complete INR 100 of that charge. Antim shulk kitne rupaye hai?

E_text: A phone's talk-time allowance rises from 200 to 250 minutes. What percentage reduction from the new allowance would restore the original allowance?
R_text: Doorbhash par baatcheet ki seema 200 se 250 minute ho jaati hai. Nayi seema mein kitne pratishat ki katauti se puraani seema milegi?
C_text: Doorbhash par baatcheet ki seema 200 se 250 minute ho gayi. What pratishat reduction from the new allowance restores the original?

E_text: At a wedding, 2/5 of guests choose tea. The other guests choose coffee, and 1/3 of those coffee drinkers request no sugar. What fraction of all guests choose unsweetened coffee?
R_text: Shaadi mein mehmaanon ka 2/5 hissa chaay leta hai. Anya mehmaan kaafi lete hain; unmein 1/3 bina cheeni maangte hain. Sab mehmaanon ka kitna hissa bina cheeni ki kaafi leta hai?
C_text: Shaadi mein 2/5 mehmaan chaay lete hain. The others choose coffee, and 1/3 of those request no sugar. Sab mehmaanon ke mukable bina cheeni ki kaafi waalon ki bhinnatmak matra kya hai?

E_text: A hostel serves 120 dinners. Forty percent are vegetarian; 25 percent of the vegetarian dinners have no dairy. How many dinners are vegetarian but include dairy?
R_text: Chhatravaas mein 120 raat ke bhojan parose gaye. 40 pratishat shaakaahaari hain; shaakaahaari bhojanon mein 25 pratishat doodh se bani cheezon ke bina hain. Kitne shaakaahaari bhojanon mein doodh se bani cheezein hain?
C_text: Chhatravaas mein 120 raat ke bhojan hain. Forty percent are vegetarian, and 25 percent of those are dairy-free. Kitne shaakaahaari bhojanon mein doodh se bani cheezein hain?

E_text: An office stores 84 archived files. Two-sevenths are scanned. After another 18 files are scanned, what fraction of the archive is scanned?
R_text: Daftar mein 84 puraani sanchikayein hain. 2/7 ki yantrik chhavi bani hai. Aur 18 ki chhavi banne par kitni bhinnatmak matra ki chhavi ban chuki hogi?
C_text: Daftar mein 84 puraani sanchikayein hain; 2/7 ki chhavi bani hai. After another 18 are scanned, what fraction of the archive is scanned?

E_text: A dispatcher marks 35% of a route complete. The next 9 km brings completion to 80%. What is the full route length?
R_text: Ravaangi adhikaari ke anusaar raaste ka 35% tay hai. Agle 9 km chalne par 80% tay ho jaata hai. Poora raasta kitne km hai?
C_text: Ravaangi adhikaari ke anusaar 35% raasta tay hai. The next 9 km brings completion to 80%. Poora raasta kitne km hai?

E_text: A hospital divides an INR 2100 grant between teams in proportion to 8 and 6 training hours. How much goes to the team with 8 hours?
R_text: Aspataal INR 2100 ka anudaan do dalon ke 8 aur 6 prashikshan ghanton ke anusaar baant deta hai. 8 ghante wale dal ko kitne rupaye milte hain?
C_text: Aspataal INR 2100 ka anudaan 8 aur 6 prashikshan ghanton ke anusaar baant deta hai. How many rupees go to the team with 8 hours?

E_text: An office printer's draft mode runs at four times its fine-mode speed. A job takes 28 minutes in fine mode. With no setup time, how long does it take in draft mode?
R_text: Daftar ke mudrak ki kacchi chhapaai ki raftaar maheen chhapaai ki 4 guna hai. Maheen mein kaam 28 minute ka hai. Taiyari ka samay na ho to kacchi chhapaai kitne minute legi?
C_text: Daftar ke mudrak ki kacchi chhapaai ki raftaar maheen ki 4 guna hai; maheen mein kaam 28 minute ka hai. With no setup time, how long does the job take in draft mode?

E_text: Two phone plans have the same monthly price and include 180 and 240 talk minutes respectively. What is the first plan's cost per minute divided by the second's?
R_text: Do doorbhash yojanaon ka maasik daam samaan hai aur baatcheet ke 180 aur 240 minute milte hain. Pehli mein ek minute ke daam ko doosri ke ek minute ke daam se vibhaajit karne par kya milega?
C_text: Do doorbhash yojanaon ka maasik daam samaan hai; baatcheet 180 aur 240 minute ki hai. What is the first plan's cost per minute divided by the second's?

E_text: Tea strength is leaf mass divided by water volume. Two hostel pots use 12 g in 2 L and 18 g in 6 L. What is the first strength divided by the second?
R_text: Chaay ki taakat patti ke bhaar ko paani ki matra se vibhaajit karke milti hai. Chhatravaas ke do bartanon mein 2 L mein 12 g aur 6 L mein 18 g patti hai. Pehli taakat ko doosri se vibhaajit karne par kya milega?
C_text: Chhatravaas mein chaay ki taakat patti ke bhaar ko paani se vibhaajit karke milti hai. One pot uses 12 g in 2 L and the other 18 g in 6 L. Pehli taakat ko doosri se vibhaajit karne par kya milega?

E_text: Two delivery zones need 3 and 5 workers for equal coverage, but have 12 and 15 workers assigned. A coverage factor is assigned workers divided by required workers. What is the first factor divided by the second?
R_text: Samaan pahunchane ke do kshetron ko samaan pahunch ke liye 3 aur 5 karmachari chahiye; lage hain 12 aur 15. Lage karmachariyon ko zaroori sankhya se vibhaajit karne par pahunch ka maan mile. Pehle maan ko doosre se vibhaajit karne par kya milega?
C_text: Samaan pahunchane ke do kshetron ko 3 aur 5 karmachari chahiye; lage hain 12 aur 15. Coverage factor is assigned workers divided by required workers. Samaan pahunch ke is maan mein pehle ko doosre se vibhaajit karne par kya milega?

E_text: A hospital tray cleaner runs 9 minutes and rests 3 minutes after every run. It starts immediately. How long from the start until its fourth run finishes, excluding any rest after that finish?
R_text: Aspataal ka thaali safaai yantra 9 minute chalta aur har chalaav ke baad 3 minute rukta hai. Woh turant shuru hota hai. Chauthe chalaav ke ant tak kitne minute lagenge, uske baad ka viraam gine bina?
C_text: Aspataal ka thaali safaai yantra 9 minute chalta aur har chalaav ke baad 3 minute rukta hai; turant shuru hota hai. How many minutes until the fourth run finishes, excluding rest after that finish?

E_text: A garden drip line releases 300 mL per minute. How many minutes does it take to release 4.5 L?
R_text: Baag ki boond sinchaai naali se 300 mL prati minute nikalta hai. 4.5 L chhodne mein kitne minute lagenge?
C_text: Baag ki boond sinchaai releases 300 mL per minute. 4.5 L chhodne mein kitne minute lagenge?

E_text: A phone pass lasts exactly 36 hours from activation. It is activated Tuesday at 18:00. At Wednesday 09:00, how many hours remain?
R_text: Doorbhash ki suvidha chalu hone se theek 36 ghante chalti hai. Woh Mangalvaar 18:00 par chalu hoti hai. Budhvaar 09:00 par kitne ghante baaki hain?
C_text: Doorbhash ki suvidha Mangalvaar 18:00 se theek 36 ghante chalti hai. At Wednesday 09:00, how many hours remain?

E_text: A library's book dryer holds at most 8 books per cycle. Each cycle lasts 15 minutes, and cycles cannot overlap. Starting with 19 wet books, how long until all are dry if loading takes no time?
R_text: Pustakalay ka kitab sukhaane wala yantra ek chakkar mein adhiktam 8 kitabein leta hai. Ek chakkar 15 minute hai aur chakkar kram se chalte hain. Rakhne mein samay na lage to 19 geeli kitabein kitne minute mein sookhengi?
C_text: Pustakalay ka sukhaane wala yantra holds at most 8 books per 15-minute cycle, with no overlapping cycles. Rakhne mein samay na lage to 19 geeli kitabein kitne minute mein sookhengi?

E_text: An event stream starts at 18:30 on a venue clock that is 90 minutes ahead of the viewer's clock. The stream lasts 50 minutes. At the end, how many minutes after 17:00 is it on the viewer's clock?
R_text: Samaroh ka prasaaran sthal ki ghadi par 18:30 ko shuru hota hai. Sthal ki ghadi darshak ki ghadi se 90 minute aage hai. Prasaaran 50 minute chalta hai. Ant mein darshak ki ghadi par 17:00 se kitne minute beet chuke honge?
C_text: Samaroh ka prasaaran sthal par 18:30 ko shuru aur 50 minute lamba hai. The venue clock is 90 minutes ahead of the viewer's clock. Ant mein darshak ki ghadi par 17:00 se kitne minute beetenge?

E_text: A hostel sets aside 2.4 kg of tea leaves for 6 days. The daily quantity is used to make 40 L of tea. How many grams of leaves are used per litre?
R_text: Chhatravaas mein 6 din ke liye 2.4 kg chaay-patti rakhi hai. Roz samaan matra se 40 L chaay banti hai. Ek L chaay mein kitne g patti lagti hai?
C_text: Chhatravaas mein 6 din ke liye 2.4 kg patti hai; roz samaan matra se 40 L chaay banti hai. How many grams of leaves are used per litre?

E_text: Three adjacent library drawers have consecutive odd-number labels in ascending order. The labels total 81. What is the first label number?
R_text: Pustakalay ki teen paas-paas ki daraazon par chadhte kram mein lagaatar visham sankhyaon ke chihn hain. In sankhyaon ka kul yog 81 hai. Pehli daraaz ki sankhya kya hai?
C_text: Pustakalay ki teen paas-paas ki daraazon par chadhte kram mein lagaatar visham sankhyaon ke chihn hain. In sankhyaon ka kul yog 81 hai. What is the first label number?

E_text: An office allocates 11 hours to planning and training in one week. The next week it doubles the planning hours and keeps training unchanged, making 18 hours for the two activities. How many hours of training are allocated each week?
R_text: Daftar mein ek hafte yojana banaane aur prashikshan ke liye 11 ghante hain. Agle hafte yojana banaane ka samay dugna hota hai aur prashikshan ka samay vahin rehta hai; donon gatividhiyon ke liye 18 ghante hote hain. Ek hafte mein prashikshan kitne ghante ka hai?
C_text: Daftar mein ek hafte yojana banaane aur prashikshan ke liye 11 ghante hain. The next week planning time doubles while training time stays unchanged, making 18 hours for the two activities. Ek hafte mein prashikshan kitne ghante ka hai?

E_text: A straight hostel corridor is marked in metres from its entrance. A water fountain is at 7 m. A cupboard is 5 m from the fountain and lies farther from the entrance than the fountain does. At what metre mark is the cupboard?
R_text: Chhatravaas ke seedhe galiyaare mein pravesh se doori m mein likhi hai. Paani ka nal 7 m par hai. Almaari nal se 5 m door hai aur pravesh se chalne par nal ke aage aati hai. Almaari kitne m ke chihn par hai?
C_text: Chhatravaas ke seedhe galiyaare mein pravesh se doori m mein likhi hai. Paani ka nal 7 m par hai. The cupboard is 5 m from the fountain and lies farther from the entrance than the fountain does. Almaari kitne m ke chihn par hai?

E_text: A hospital opens a new ward when occupied beds reach 86. The current occupancy is 9 fewer than that trigger. How many beds are occupied now?
R_text: Aspataal mein naya kaksh tab khulta hai jab 86 bistar bhare hon. Abhi bhare bistaron ki sankhya is seema se 9 kam hai. Abhi kitne bistar bhare hain?
C_text: Aspataal mein naya kaksh kholne ki seema 86 bhare bistar hai. Abhi sankhya isse 9 kam hai. How many beds are occupied now?

E_text: An office allows 18 minutes of late arrival per week before a warning. A worker's recorded delay is 7 minutes more than this allowance. What delay is recorded?
R_text: Daftar mein hafte bhar ki deri 18 minute tak ho to chetavani nahi milti. Ek karmachari ki darj deri is chhoot se 7 minute zyada hai. Uski darj deri kitne minute hai?
C_text: Daftar mein hafte ki deri ki chhoot 18 minute hai. Ek karmachari ki darj deri isse 7 minute zyada hai. What delay is recorded in minutes?

E_text: A library reserves a room for 55 minutes. Setup takes 8 minutes and the reading takes 32 minutes. How many minutes remain for discussion within the reservation?
R_text: Pustakalay ka kamra 55 minute ke liye tay hai. Taiyari mein 8 minute aur paath mein 32 minute lagte hain. Isi avadhi mein charcha ke liye kitne minute baaki hain?
C_text: Pustakalay ka kamra 55 minute ke liye tay hai. Taiyari mein 8 minute aur paath mein 32 minute lagte hain. How many minutes are baaki for discussion within this booking?

E_text: A phone has 43 photos in one album and 29 in another. Twelve photos appear in both. How many distinct photos are there across the two albums?
R_text: Ek doorbhash ke ek chitra-sangrah mein 43 tasveerein aur doosre mein 29 hain. 12 tasveerein dono sangrahon mein hain. Dono sangrahon mein kul kitni alag tasveerein hain?
C_text: Doorbhash ke do chitra-sangrahon mein 43 aur 29 tasveerein hain; 12 dono mein hain. What is the kul count of distinct photos across the albums?

E_text: An event hall has 96 chairs. Staff remove 14 for a camera lane, then put 6 of those chairs along the back wall. How many chairs are in the hall afterward?
R_text: Samaroh ke kaksh mein 96 kursiyan hain. Karmachari chitrankan ke raaste ke liye 14 kursiyan nikaal dete hain, phir unmein se 6 pichhli deewar ke paas rakh dete hain. Ab kaksh mein kitni kursiyan hain?
C_text: Samaroh ke kaksh mein 96 kursiyan hain. Staff remove 14 for the filming lane, then put 6 of those chairs along the back wall. Ab kaksh mein kitni kursiyan hain?

E_text: A hostel kitchen prepares 72 meal trays. At the end, 11 untouched trays remain and 4 additional trays were spoiled before service. How many trays were served?
R_text: Chhatravaas ki rasoi mein 72 bhojan ki thaaliyan taiyar hui. Ant mein 11 achhooti thaaliyon ka bhojan bacha hai; iske alava 4 thaaliyon ka bhojan parosne se pehle kharab hua. Kitni thaaliyan parosi gayin?
C_text: Chhatravaas ki rasoi mein 72 thaaliyan taiyar hui. Eleven untouched trays remain, and another 4 were spoiled before service. Kitni thaaliyan parosi gayin?

E_text: A delivery rider's afternoon distance is 6 km more than the morning distance. The afternoon record is 23 km. What was the morning distance?
R_text: Samaan pahunchane wale ki dopahar ki doori subah ki doori se 6 km zyada hai. Dopahar ki darj doori 23 km hai. Subah ki doori kitne km thi?
C_text: Samaan pahunchane wale ki afternoon distance is 6 km more than the morning distance. Dopahar mein 23 km darj hain. Subah kitne km chale the?

E_text: Two hospital teams together must cover 60 appointment slots. One team covers 26; a visiting team covers 9 of the other team's allocation. How many slots must the other regular team cover itself?
R_text: Aspataal ke do dal milkar 60 mulaqaton ki zimmedari lete hain. Ek dal 26 sambhalta hai. Mehmaan dal doosre dal ke zimmedari wale 9 sambhalta hai. Doosre niyamit dal ko khud kitni mulaqatein sambhalni hain?
C_text: Aspataal ke two teams together must cover 60 appointments. Ek dal 26 sambhalta hai; mehmaan dal doosre ki zimmedari mein se 9 sambhalta hai. Doosre niyamit dal ko khud kitni mulaqatein sambhalni hain?

E_text: On a single day, two office duty windows run from 09:10 to 10:00 and from 09:35 to 10:20. For how many minutes do the windows overlap?
R_text: Ek hi din daftar ki do duty avadhiyan 09:10 se 10:00 aur 09:35 se 10:20 tak hain. Dono avadhiyan kitne minute ek saath chalti hain?
C_text: Daftar ki do duty avadhiyan 09:10 se 10:00 aur 09:35 se 10:20 tak hain, ek hi din. For how many minutes do they overlap?

E_text: A damaged section of a library book runs from page 118 through page 126, including both endpoints. How many pages require scanning?
R_text: Pustakalay ki kitab mein panna 118 se panna 126 tak, dono sire samet, kshati hai. Kitne pannon ki chhavi banani hogi?
C_text: Pustakalay ki kitab mein panna 118 se 126 tak kshati hai, including both endpoints. Kitne pannon ki chhavi banani hogi?

E_text: At a wedding entrance, a guest has 17 people ahead in the queue. Before that guest reaches the desk, 5 of those people leave the queue. What is the guest's new position, counting the first person as position 1?
R_text: Shaadi ke pravesh par ek mehmaan ke aage 17 log hain. Uski baari se pehle unmein se 5 log pankti chhod dete hain. Pehle vyakti ko sthaan 1 maanein to mehmaan ka naya sthaan kya hai?
C_text: Shaadi ke pravesh par mehmaan ke aage 17 log hain; unmein se 5 pankti chhod dete hain. What is the guest's new position, with the first person numbered 1?

E_text: A hostel lists 38 residents for dinner. Six listed residents do not attend, and 9 unlisted guests attend instead. How many diners attend?
R_text: Chhatravaas ki raat ke bhojan ki soochi mein 38 nivaasi hain. Soochi ke 6 nivaasi nahi aate aur soochi se baahar ke 9 mehmaan aate hain. Bhojan mein kitne log aate hain?
C_text: Chhatravaas ki bhojan soochi mein 38 nivaasi hain. Six listed residents are absent and 9 unlisted guests attend. Bhojan mein kitne log aate hain?

E_text: A delivery route has three legs of 4 km, 7 km and 3 km. A direct road between the same start and finish is 9 km. How many kilometres would using the direct road save?
R_text: Samaan pahunchane ka raasta 4 km, 7 km aur 3 km ke teen khandon se banta hai. Usi shuruaat aur ant ke beech seedhi sadak 9 km hai. Seedhi sadak se kitne km ki doori ki bachat hogi?
C_text: Samaan pahunchane ke raaste ke teen khand 4 km, 7 km aur 3 km hain. The direct road between the same endpoints is 9 km. Usse kitne km ki bachat hogi?

E_text: An office filing deadline is 18:00. Checking takes 35 minutes and uploading then takes 20 minutes, with no gap. At what number of minutes after 17:00 must checking begin to finish exactly at the deadline?
R_text: Daftar mein kaagaz jama karne ki antim ghadi 18:00 hai. Jaanch mein 35 minute aur uske turant baad bhejne mein 20 minute lagte hain. Theek antim ghadi par poora karne ke liye jaanch 17:00 ke kitne minute baad shuru ho?
C_text: Daftar mein antim ghadi 18:00 hai. Checking takes 35 minutes and uploading immediately afterward takes 20 minutes. Theek 18:00 par poora karne ke liye jaanch 17:00 ke kitne minute baad shuru ho?

E_text: An office pays INR 80 per hour for the first 2 hours of an evening duty and INR 110 for the next hour. What is the payment for exactly 3 hours?
R_text: Daftar shaam ke kaam ke pehle 2 ghanton ke liye INR 80 prati ghanta aur agle ghante ke liye INR 110 deta hai. Theek 3 ghante ke kaam ka bhugtaan kitne rupaye hai?
C_text: Daftar shaam ke kaam ke pehle 2 ghanton ke liye INR 80 prati ghanta aur agle ghante ke liye INR 110 deta hai. What is the payment for exactly 3 hours?

E_text: A rainwater inspection has a base fee of INR 600. A 10 percent service charge applies to that fee, and an INR 50 voucher is deducted afterward. What is the amount payable?
R_text: Baarish ka paani jama karne ki vyavastha ki jaanch ka mool shulk INR 600 hai. Is par 10 pratishat seva shulk lagta hai, phir INR 50 ki chhoot milti hai. Kitne rupaye dene honge?
C_text: Baarish ka paani jama karne ki vyavastha ki jaanch INR 600 ki hai. Is par 10 pratishat seva shulk lagta hai, phir INR 50 ki chhoot hai. What is the amount payable in rupees?

E_text: A library charges INR 240 to reproduce a manuscript. The reader pays INR 300 and asks that INR 25 of the change become a donation. How many rupees should the library give back?
R_text: Pustakalay mein hastalipi ki nakal ka shulk INR 240 hai. Paathak INR 300 deta hai aur chhutte mein se INR 25 daan karne ko kehta hai. Pustakalay kitne rupaye vaapas de?
C_text: Pustakalay mein hastalipi ki nakal ka shulk INR 240 hai; paathak INR 300 deta hai aur INR 25 chhutte se daan karta hai. How many rupees should be given vaapas?

E_text: A phone service's annual renewal costs INR 1440, which is INR 180 less than twelve monthly renewals combined. What does one monthly renewal cost, if all twelve cost the same?
R_text: Doorbhash seva ka saalana naveekaran INR 1440 ka hai. Yeh 12 maasik naveekaranon ke kharch se INR 180 kam hai. Sab maasik naveekaranon ka daam samaan ho to ek ka daam kitne rupaye hai?
C_text: Doorbhash seva ka saalana naveekaran INR 1440 ka hai, which is INR 180 less than twelve monthly renewals combined. Sab maasik daam samaan hain; ek ka daam kitne rupaye hai?

E_text: An event sound bill is INR 3600. A sponsor pays INR 900, and the unpaid amount is divided equally among 3 organising groups. How much does each group pay?
R_text: Samaroh mein dhvani vyavastha ka kharch INR 3600 hai. Sahayak sanstha INR 900 deti hai; anadaayi raashi 3 aayojak dalon mein samaan roop se baant di jaati hai. Ek dal kitne rupaye dega?
C_text: Samaroh mein dhvani vyavastha INR 3600 ki hai; sahayak sanstha INR 900 deti hai. The unpaid amount is split equally among 3 organising groups. Ek dal kitne rupaye dega?

E_text: A hostel has INR 780 in a repair fund. It must keep INR 180 untouched and can use the rest for identical latch kits costing INR 75 each. How many kits can it buy?
R_text: Chhatravaas ki marammat nidhi mein INR 780 hain. INR 180 surakshit rakhne hain; bacha paisa INR 75 ke samaan kundi-saamaanon par lag sakta hai. Aise kitne kundi-saamaan liye ja sakte hain?
C_text: Chhatravaas ki marammat nidhi INR 780 hai. After reserving INR 180, the remaining money buys latch kits at INR 75 each. Kitne kundi-saamaan liye ja sakte hain?

E_text: An office reimburses travel up to INR 500 per trip. A worker spends INR 640 on travel and INR 90 on meals; meals are not reimbursed. What is the worker's unreimbursed expense?
R_text: Daftar ek yatra ke safar ka INR 500 tak kharch chukata hai. Karmachari safar par INR 640 aur khaane par INR 90 kharch karta hai; khaane ka kharch nahi chukaya jaata. Karmachari ke apne kitne rupaye lagte hain?
C_text: Daftar safar ka INR 500 tak chukata hai. Karmachari ke safar ka kharch INR 640 aur khaane ka INR 90 hai. Meals are not reimbursed. Karmachari ke apne kitne rupaye lagte hain?

E_text: A garden sensor rental costs INR 95 a day. The sensor is collected Monday morning and returned Thursday evening; both collection and return days are charged. What is the rental bill?
R_text: Baag ka maapak yantra INR 95 roz par milta hai. Use Somvaar subah liya aur Guruvaar shaam lautaya; lene aur lautaane ke dinon ka bhi shulk lagta hai. Kiraaya kitne rupaye hai?
C_text: Baag ka maapak yantra INR 95 roz ka hai; Somvaar subah liya aur Guruvaar shaam lautaya. Both collection and return days are charged. Kiraaya kitne rupaye hai?

E_text: A phone service credit of INR 100 is sold for INR 92. A user buys 3 such credits and spends INR 245 of service credit. How many rupees of service credit remain available?
R_text: Doorbhash seva mein INR 100 ka upyog-adhikaar INR 92 mein milta hai. Ek vyakti aise 3 adhikaar leta hai aur INR 245 ka upyog karta hai. Ab kitne rupaye ka upyog-adhikaar upalabdh hai?
C_text: Doorbhash seva mein INR 100 ka upyog-adhikaar INR 92 mein milta hai; vyakti aise 3 leta hai. After spending INR 245 of service credit, how much credit remains in rupees?

E_text: A wedding venue offers either an INR 4200 flat cleaning fee or INR 18 per attendee. For 200 attendees, how much cheaper is the attendee-based option?
R_text: Shaadi ki jagah par safai ke liye INR 4200 ka ekmusht shulk ya ek mehmaan ke INR 18 diye ja sakte hain. 200 mehmaanon ke liye doosra vikalp kitne rupaye sasta hai?
C_text: Shaadi ki jagah par safai ka ekmusht shulk INR 4200 hai, or INR 18 per attendee. 200 mehmaanon ke liye doosra vikalp kitne rupaye sasta hai?

E_text: A hostel meal card requires an INR 60 activation fee and INR 32 for a meal. A resident pays INR 220 on first activation and receives only whole meals, with no refund. How many meals are credited?
R_text: Chhatravaas ka bhojan patra chalu karne ka shulk INR 60 aur ek bhojan ka daam INR 32 hai. Nivaasi pehli baar INR 220 deta hai. Sirf poore bhojan milte hain, koi raashi lautayi nahi jaati. Kitne bhojan darj honge?
C_text: Chhatravaas ke bhojan patra ko chalu karna INR 60 ka hai; ek bhojan INR 32 ka. The first payment is INR 220 and only whole meals are credited, with no refund. Kitne bhojan darj honge?

E_text: A delivery worker is paid INR 24 for a successful stop and INR 8 for an attempted but unsuccessful stop. Of 15 stops, 3 are unsuccessful. What is the worker's pay?
R_text: Samaan pahunchane wale ko safal padaav par INR 24 aur asafal koshish wale padaav par INR 8 milte hain. 15 padaavon mein 3 asafal hain. Uska bhugtaan kitne rupaye hai?
C_text: Samaan pahunchane wale ke 15 padaavon mein 3 asafal hain. Successful stops pay INR 24 and unsuccessful attempts pay INR 8. Bhugtaan kitne rupaye hai?

E_text: An office employee owes INR 430 for a personal print job. Payroll already withheld INR 500, then refunded INR 40. How much is still owed back to the employee?
R_text: Daftar ke karmachari ko apni chhapaai ke INR 430 dene the. Vetan se INR 500 roke gaye aur phir INR 40 lautaye gaye. Ab karmachari ko aur kitne rupaye lautaane hain?
C_text: Daftar mein niji chhapaai ka dena INR 430 tha; vetan se INR 500 roke gaye. After an INR 40 refund, how much is still owed back to the employee?

E_text: A hospital report has 80 pages. Three-eighths are charts, and half of those chart pages require a colour copy. How many pages require a colour copy?
R_text: Aspataal ki rapat 80 pannon ki hai. Uska 3/8 hissa aarekhon ka hai, aur aarekh wale pannon mein aadhe ki rangeen nakal chahiye. Kitne pannon ki rangeen nakal chahiye?
C_text: Aspataal ki rapat 80 pannon ki hai; 3/8 hissa aarekhon ka aur unmein aadhe ki rangeen nakal chahiye. How many pages require a colour copy?

E_text: An office survey receives 42 replies, representing 70 percent of invited workers. How many workers were invited?
R_text: Daftar ke sarvekshan mein 42 jawaab aaye, jo bulaaye karmachariyon ke 70 pratishat hain. Kitne karmachari bulaaye gaye the?
C_text: Daftar ke sarvekshan mein 42 jawaab aaye, jo bulaaye karmachariyon ke 70 pratishat hain. How many workers were invited?

E_text: A garden's soil sensor rises from 24 percent moisture to 39 percent moisture. What is the increase as a percentage of the original reading?
R_text: Baag ke mitti maapak par nami 24 pratishat se 39 pratishat ho jaati hai. Shuruaati maap ke mukable vriddhi kitne pratishat hai?
C_text: Baag ke mitti maapak par nami 24 pratishat se 39 pratishat ho jaati hai. What is the increase as a percentage of the original reading?

E_text: A library has 40 reference books, of which 10 are illustrated, and 60 lending books, of which 30 are illustrated. What fraction of all these books is illustrated?
R_text: Pustakalay mein 40 sandarbh kitabein hain, jinmein 10 sachitra hain, aur 60 udhaar wali kitabein hain, jinmein 30 sachitra hain. In kitabon ka kitna hissa sachitra hai?
C_text: Pustakalay mein 40 sandarbh kitabon mein 10 aur 60 udhaar kitabon mein 30 sachitra hain. What hissa of all these books is illustrated, as a fraction?

E_text: A phone's listed repair price is increased by 20 percent and then the new price is reduced by 20 percent. What percentage of the original price is the final price?
R_text: Doorbhash ki marammat ka likha daam pehle 20 pratishat badhta hai. Phir naye daam par 20 pratishat ki chhoot milti hai. Antim daam mool daam ka kitna pratishat hai?
C_text: Doorbhash ki marammat ka daam rises by 20 percent, then falls by 20 percent of the new price. Antim daam mool daam ka kitna percent hai?

E_text: A wedding hall is 3/5 full. Of the occupied seats, 2/9 are beside an aisle. What fraction of all seats is occupied by people sitting beside an aisle?
R_text: Shaadi ke kaksh ki 3/5 jagahen bhari hain. Bhari jagahon ka 2/9 hissa galiyaare ke paas hai. Sabhi jagahon mein galiyaare ke paas bhari jagahon ka kitna hissa hai?
C_text: Shaadi ke kaksh ki 3/5 jagahen bhari hain. Of the occupied seats, 2/9 are beside an aisle. Sabhi jagahon ke mukable aisi bhari jagahon ki bhinnatmak matra kya hai?

E_text: A delivery log records 15 completed stops out of 24 assigned stops. Write the completed fraction in lowest terms. What is its numerator?
R_text: Samaan pahunchane ki bahi mein 24 tay padaavon mein 15 poore hain. Poore padaavon ki bhinn ko saraltam roop mein likhein. Uska ansh kya hai?
C_text: Samaan pahunchane ki bahi mein 24 tay padaavon mein 15 poore hain. Reduce the completed fraction to lowest terms. Uska numerator kya hai?

E_text: A clinic's weekly attendance changes from 80 patients to 92. Express the increase as a fraction of the new attendance.
R_text: Chikitsaalay mein saaptaahik aagaman 80 mareezon se 92 mareezon ka ho jaata hai. Vriddhi ko naye aagaman ki sankhya se vibhaajit karne par kya milega?
C_text: Chikitsaalay mein saaptaahik aagaman 80 se 92 mareezon ka ho jaata hai. Express the increase as a fraction of the new attendance.

E_text: An office team completes 5/8 of a report on Monday. On Tuesday it completes 2/5 of what was unfinished. What fraction of the entire report is completed on Tuesday?
R_text: Daftar ka dal Somvaar ko rapat ka 5/8 poora karta hai. Mangalvaar ko adhure kaam ka 2/5 poora karta hai. Mangalvaar ka kaam poori rapat ki kitni bhinnatmak matra hai?
C_text: Daftar ka dal Somvaar ko rapat ka 5/8 poora karta hai. On Tuesday it completes 2/5 of the unfinished work. Mangalvaar ka kaam poori rapat ki kitni bhinnatmak matra hai?

E_text: A rainfall gauge contains 18 mL. This is 3/4 of its capacity. After 2 mL evaporates, what fraction of capacity is filled?
R_text: Baarish maapak mein 18 mL paani hai, jo uski kshamata ka 3/4 hai. Phir 2 mL paani bhaap ban jaata hai. Ab bhara paani kshamata ki kitni bhinnatmak matra hai?
C_text: Baarish maapak mein 18 mL paani hai, kshamata ka 3/4. After 2 mL evaporates, what fraction of capacity is filled?

E_text: A library catalogue has 150 entries. Exactly 60% are checked. How many unchecked entries must be checked to reach 80% of the catalogue?
R_text: Pustakalay ki soochi mein 150 pravishtiyan hain. Theek 60% ki jaanch hui hai. 80% tak pahunchne ke liye kitni anjaanchi pravishtiyon ki jaanch chahiye?
C_text: Pustakalay ki soochi mein 150 pravishtiyan hain; 60% jaanchi hain. How many unchecked entries must be checked to reach 80%?

E_text: A phone screen shows 3/10 of a document at once at its current text size. Enlarging the text halves the visible fraction. What fraction of the document is then visible at once?
R_text: Doorbhash ke parde par maujooda akshar-aakaar mein dastaavez ka 3/10 ek saath dikhta hai. Aksharon ka aakaar badhaane se dikhne wali matra aadhi ho jaati hai. Ab dastaavez ki kitni bhinnatmak matra ek saath dikhegi?
C_text: Doorbhash ke parde par dastaavez ka 3/10 ek saath dikhta hai. Enlarging the text halves the visible fraction. Ab kitni bhinnatmak matra ek saath dikhegi?

E_text: At an event, 3/4 of the invitations receive a reply. Of the replies, 4/5 are acceptances. If 48 invitations are accepted, how many invitations were sent?
R_text: Samaroh ke nimantranon mein 3/4 ka jawaab aata hai. Jawaabon mein 4/5 sveekriti hain. Agar 48 nimantran sveekrit hain to kitne nimantran bheje gaye the?
C_text: Samaroh ke nimantranon mein 3/4 ka jawaab aata hai aur unmein 4/5 sveekriti hain. If 48 invitations are accepted, how many invitations were sent?

E_text: In a hostel, 2/3 of residents eat breakfast and 3/4 eat dinner. Exactly 1/2 of all residents eat both. What fraction eat at least one of the two meals?
R_text: Chhatravaas ke nivaasiyon mein 2/3 naashta aur 3/4 raat ka bhojan karte hain. Theek 1/2 dono karte hain. Kam-se-kam ek bhojan karne waale nivaasiyon ki bhinnatmak matra kya hai?
C_text: Chhatravaas mein 2/3 nivaasi naashta aur 3/4 raat ka bhojan karte hain; 1/2 dono karte hain. What fraction eat at least one of these meals?

E_text: A delivery route is 12 km long. Its first 1/3 is uphill and the next 1/4 of the whole route is level. What fraction of the route has been covered after those two sections?
R_text: Samaan pahunchane ka raasta 12 km hai. Shuruaat ka 1/3 chadhaai hai aur agla samatal khand poore raaste ka 1/4 hai. In do khandon ke baad poore raaste ki kitni bhinnatmak matra tay hui hai?
C_text: Samaan pahunchane ka raasta 12 km hai; pehla 1/3 chadhaai hai. The next section is level and equals 1/4 of the whole route. In dono ke baad kitni bhinnatmak matra tay hai?

E_text: A park's map uses 45% of its area for woodland and 30% for grassland, with no overlap. What percentage of the non-woodland area is grassland?
R_text: Udyan ke nakshay mein 45% kshetra van aur 30% ghaas hai; dono kshetra alag hain. Van se baahar ke kshetra ke mukable ghaas ka kshetra kitne % hai?
C_text: Udyan ke nakshay mein 45% van aur 30% ghaas hai; dono alag hain. What percentage of the non-woodland area is grassland?

E_text: A hospital shares 48 lockers between two wards in the ratio 5:3. How many lockers are in the second ward's share?
R_text: Aspataal ke 48 saamaan-khaane do kakshon ko 5:3 mein milte hain. Doosre kaksh ka hissa kitne saamaan-khaanon ka hai?
C_text: Aspataal ke 48 saamaan-khaane do kakshon ko 5:3 mein milte hain. How many lockers are in the second ward's hissa?

E_text: An office training room has three times as many seats as its interview room, which has 14 seats. How many seats are in the training room?
R_text: Daftar ke prashikshan kaksh mein saakshaatkaar kaksh ki 3 guna jagahen hain. Saakshaatkaar kaksh mein 14 jagahen hain. Prashikshan kaksh mein kitni hain?
C_text: Daftar ke prashikshan kaksh mein saakshaatkaar kaksh ki 3 guna jagahen hain; saakshaatkaar kaksh mein 14 hain. How many seats are in the training room?

E_text: Two nursery beds contain saplings in the ratio 7:4. The first has 18 more than the second. How many saplings are in the second bed?
R_text: Paudhshaala ki do kyaariyon mein paudhe 7:4 mein hain. Pehli mein doosri se 18 zyada hain. Doosri mein kitne paudhe hain?
C_text: Paudhshaala ki do kyaariyon mein paudhe 7:4 mein hain; pehli mein 18 zyada hain. How many saplings are in the second bed?

E_text: A library wants its repaired-to-awaiting-repair book ratio to equal 3:2. It has 24 repaired books and 20 awaiting repair. Without changing any book's state, how many already-repaired donated books are needed?
R_text: Pustakalay mein theek aur marammat ke intezaar wali kitabon ka sambandh 3:2 ke baraabar chahiye. Abhi 24 theek aur 20 intezaar mein hain. Sthiti badle bina kitni pehle se theek daan ki kitabein chahiye?
C_text: Pustakalay mein 24 theek aur 20 intezaar wali kitabein hain; sambandh 3:2 ke baraabar chahiye. Without changing any book's state, how many already-repaired donated books are needed?

E_text: A phone display strip has text and blank space in the ratio 7:3. Text occupies 14 cm. If 2 cm of blank space is cropped, how much blank space remains?
R_text: Doorbhash ke parde ki patti mein likha aur khaali hissa 7:3 mein hai. Likha sthaan 14 cm hai. Khaali sthaan se 2 cm hataane par kitna cm khaali sthaan rahega?
C_text: Doorbhash ke parde ki patti mein likha aur khaali sthaan 7:3 mein hai; likha sthaan 14 cm hai. If 2 cm of blank space is cropped, how many centimetres of blank space remain?

E_text: A wedding's first flower order has 60 stems split between marigolds and roses in the ratio 4:1. A second order has 12 marigolds and 18 roses. How many rose stems are in the two orders?
R_text: Shaadi ke pehle aadesh ki 60 phool-dandiyan gende aur gulaab mein 4:1 ke sambandh se baant di jaati hain. Doosre mein 12 gende aur 18 gulaab hain. Dono mein gulaab ki kitni dandiyan hain?
C_text: Shaadi ke pehle aadesh ki 60 dandiyan are split between marigolds and roses in the ratio 4:1. Doosre mein 12 gende aur 18 gulaab hain. Dono mein gulaab ki kitni dandiyan hain?

E_text: A hostel has twice as many cups as bowls and three times as many bowls as jugs. What is the cup count divided by the jug count?
R_text: Chhatravaas mein pyaale katoron ke 2 guna aur katore jagon ke 3 guna hain. Pyaalon ki sankhya ko jagon ki sankhya se vibhaajit karne par kya milega?
C_text: Chhatravaas mein cups are twice as numerous as bowls, and bowls are three times as numerous as jugs. Pyaalon ki sankhya ko jagon ki sankhya se vibhaajit karne par kya milega?

E_text: A hospital linen bundle contains sheets, pillowcases and towels in the ratio 2:3:4. There are 27 items. How many are pillowcases?
R_text: Aspataal ki kapdon ki gathri mein chaadarein, takiye ke gilaaf aur tauliye 2:3:4 mein hain. 27 vastuyein hain. Takiye ke kitne gilaaf hain?
C_text: Aspataal ki gathri mein chaadarein, takiye ke gilaaf aur tauliye 2:3:4 mein hain, with 27 items altogether. Takiye ke kitne gilaaf hain?

E_text: Office discussion and silent work are planned in the ratio 2:5. Silent work lasts 35 minutes. Discussion then ends 3 minutes earlier than planned. How long does discussion last?
R_text: Daftar mein charcha aur shaant kaam ka samay 2:5 mein tay hai. Shaant kaam 35 minute hai. Charcha tay samay se 3 minute pehle khatm hoti hai. Charcha kitne minute chalti hai?
C_text: Daftar mein charcha aur shaant kaam ka samay 2:5 mein hai; shaant kaam 35 minute hai. Discussion ends 3 minutes earlier than planned. Woh kitne minute chalti hai?

E_text: On a park map, 3 cm represents 120 m. A path is drawn as 8.5 cm. How long is the real path in metres?
R_text: Udyan ke nakshay mein 3 cm se 120 m dikhaye jaate hain. Ek raasta 8.5 cm bana hai. Asli raasta kitne m hai?
C_text: Udyan ke nakshay mein 3 cm represents 120 m. Raasta 8.5 cm bana hai. Asli raasta kitne m hai?

E_text: Two library wall coverings have the same height and widths in the ratio 3:5. The narrower covering needs 12 L of paint. At the same paint coverage, how many litres does the wider one need?
R_text: Pustakalay ki do deewaron ki oonchai samaan aur chaudaai 3:5 mein hai. Sankari deewar par 12 L rang lagta hai. Samaan motaai mein rangne par chaudi deewar ko kitne L chahiye?
C_text: Pustakalay ki do deewaron ki oonchai samaan aur chaudaai 3:5 mein hai; sankari par 12 L rang lagta hai. At the same paint coverage, how many litres does the wider wall need?

E_text: A document fills 18 phone screens at 20 lines per screen. A new text size fits 30 lines per screen. With all lines fitting exactly, how many screens are needed?
R_text: Dastaavez doorbhash ke 18 pardo mein aata hai, ek parde par 20 panktiyan. Naye akshar-aakaar par ek parde mein 30 panktiyan aati hain. Panktiyan theek samaane par kitne parde chahiye?
C_text: Doorbhash par dastaavez 18 pardo mein hai, ek par 20 panktiyan. The new size fits 30 lines per screen, with all lines fitting exactly. Kitne parde chahiye?

E_text: At a wedding gate, guests and staff arrive in the ratio 9:2. Staff constitute 1 out of every k arrivals on average. What is k?
R_text: Shaadi ke pravesh par mehmaan aur karmachari 9:2 mein aate hain. Ausatan k aagamanon mein 1 karmachari hai. k kya hai?
C_text: Shaadi ke pravesh par mehmaan aur karmachari 9:2 mein aate hain. Staff constitute 1 out of every k arrivals on average. k kya hai?

E_text: A hostel cleaning mixture contains concentrate and water in the ratio 1:7, with 2 L concentrate and 14 L water. Only 2 L water evaporates. What is the new water volume divided by concentrate volume?
R_text: Chhatravaas ke safai ghol mein saandr drav aur paani 1:7 mein hain: 2 L saandr drav aur 14 L paani. Sirf 2 L paani bhaap banta hai. Ab paani ko saandr drav ki matra se vibhaajit karne par kya milega?
C_text: Chhatravaas ke ghol mein saandr drav aur paani 1:7 mein hain: 2 L aur 14 L. Only 2 L water evaporates. Ab paani ko saandr drav ki matra se vibhaajit karne par kya milega?

E_text: Two hospital laundry pipes together fill a tank at 18 L per minute. An open outlet drains 5 L per minute. Starting empty, how much water is in the tank after 4 minutes?
R_text: Aspataal ki dhulaai ke do nal milkar ek minute mein 18 L bharte hain. Khula nikaas ek minute mein 5 L bahaata hai. Khaali tanki mein 4 minute baad kitna L paani hoga?
C_text: Aspataal ki dhulaai ke do nal milkar ek minute mein 18 L bharte hain; nikaas ek minute mein 5 L bahaata hai. Starting empty, how many litres are in the tank after 4 minutes?

E_text: An office reminder sounds every 12 minutes, starting at 09:00. How many reminders sound from 09:00 through 10:00, including both endpoints?
R_text: Daftar ki ghanti 09:00 se har 12 minute par bajti hai. 09:00 se 10:00 tak, dono sire samet, kitni baar bajti hai?
C_text: Daftar ki ghanti 09:00 se har 12 minute par bajti hai. How many reminders sound through 10:00, including both endpoints?

E_text: Rain falls steadily at 6 mm per hour for 2.5 hours. Before the rain the day's gauge reading was 4 mm. What is the day's final reading?
R_text: Baarish 2.5 ghante tak 6 mm prati ghanta ki sthir dar se hoti hai. Isse pehle din ka maap 4 mm tha. Din ka antim maap kitne mm hai?
C_text: Baarish 2.5 ghante tak 6 mm prati ghanta hoti hai; pehle din ka maap 4 mm tha. What is the day's final reading in mm?

E_text: A library scanner processes 7 pages per minute. Of a 180-page batch, 40 pages have already been scanned. How many more minutes are needed to scan the remaining pages without pauses?
R_text: Pustakalay ka chhavi yantra ek minute mein 7 panne karta hai. 180 pannon mein 40 ho chuke hain. Bina ruke baaki panne karne mein aur kitne minute lagenge?
C_text: Pustakalay ka chhavi yantra ek minute mein 7 panne karta hai; 180 mein 40 ho chuke hain. How many more minutes are needed for the baaki pages without pauses?

E_text: A phone gains 4 percentage points of charge per minute for 5 minutes. For the next 3 minutes it charges at half that speed. Starting at 30%, what percentage does it reach?
R_text: Doorbhash ka aavesh 5 minute tak ek minute mein 4 pratishat-ank badhta hai. Agle 3 minute mein raftaar pehli ki 0.5 guna hai. 30% se shuru karke aavesh kitne % par pahunchega?
C_text: Doorbhash 30% se shuru hota hai. It gains 4 percentage points per minute for 5 minutes, then charges at half that speed for 3 minutes. Ant mein kitne % par pahunchega?

E_text: An event serving line has a plating station handling 18 meals per minute and a handover station handling 6 fewer meals per minute. Every meal passes through both. With enough food and no other delays, what is the line's maximum sustained output per minute?
R_text: Samaroh mein thaali sajaane ka sthaan ek minute mein 18 bhojan taiyar karta hai. Thaali dene wala sthaan ek minute mein usse 6 kam bhojan deta hai. Sab bhojan dono se guzarte hain. Paryapt khaana ho aur anya deri na ho to ek minute mein sthir roop se kitne bhojan diye ja sakte hain?
C_text: Samaroh mein thaali sajaana ek minute mein 18 bhojan ka hai; the handover station handles 6 fewer meals per minute. Sab bhojan dono se guzarte hain, khaana paryapt hai aur anya deri nahi. Ek minute mein adhiktam sthir utpaadan kitna hai?

E_text: One hostel machine washes a batch in 12 minutes and another washes an identical batch in 18 minutes. They work independently on divisible laundry. How many minutes would both working together need for one batch's worth?
R_text: Chhatravaas ki ek dhulaai machine ek khep 12 minute mein aur doosri waisi khep 18 minute mein dhoti hai. Kaam vibhaajya hai aur dono alag chalti hain. Dono milkar ek khep jitna kaam kitne minute mein karengi?
C_text: Chhatravaas ki do dhulaai machinein ek khep 12 aur 18 minute mein karti hain. They work independently on divisible laundry; their rates add. Ek khep jitna kaam dono kitne minute mein karengi?

E_text: A delivery vehicle covers 27 km in 45 minutes at steady speed. What is that speed in kilometres per hour?
R_text: Samaan ki gaadi sthir raftaar par 45 minute mein 27 km chalti hai. Uski raftaar kitne km prati ghanta hai?
C_text: Samaan ki gaadi sthir raftaar par 45 minute mein 27 km chalti hai. What is its speed in kilometres per hour?

E_text: Hospital laundry uses 750 mL of cleaner for one wash. There are 8 washes a day. How many litres of cleaner are used in a day?
R_text: Aspataal ki dhulaai mein ek baar 750 mL safaai drav lagta hai. Din mein 8 baar dhulaai hoti hai. Ek din mein kitne L drav lagta hai?
C_text: Aspataal mein ek dhulaai ko 750 mL drav lagta hai; din mein 8 dhulaaiyan hain. How many litres of cleaner are used in a day?

E_text: An office backup begins at 23:40 and ends at 01:15 the next day. It pauses for 10 minutes within that interval. How many minutes is it actively running?
R_text: Daftar mein surakshit nakal banaana 23:40 par shuru aur agle din 01:15 par khatm hota hai. Beech mein 10 minute rukta hai. Vaastav mein kitne minute kaam chalta hai?
C_text: Daftar ki surakshit nakal 23:40 se agle din 01:15 tak banti hai, with a 10-minute pause. Kitne minute kaam chalta hai?

E_text: A tagged reed is 18 cm tall on Monday morning and 30 cm tall on Thursday morning. Growth is steady. What is its growth rate in centimetres per day?
R_text: Chihnit narkat Somvaar subah 18 cm aur Guruvaar subah 30 cm ooncha hai. Uski badhat sthir hai. Roz kitne cm badhta hai?
C_text: Chihnit narkat Somvaar subah 18 cm aur Guruvaar subah 30 cm hai. Growth is steady. Roz kitne cm badhta hai?

E_text: A library copier outputs 6 double-sided sheets per minute, with one page on each side. How many minutes are needed for 144 pages if every sheet is filled?
R_text: Pustakalay ka nakal yantra ek minute mein dono taraf chhape 6 kaagaz deta hai, ek taraf ek panna. Sab taraf chhaapne par 144 pannon ke liye kitne minute chahiye?
C_text: Pustakalay ka nakal yantra ek minute mein 6 double-sided sheets deta hai, one page per side. Sab taraf chhaapne par 144 pannon ke liye kitne minute chahiye?

E_text: A phone plays a 48-minute recording at 1.5 times normal speed. Playback stops for a 6-minute call, then resumes at the same speed. What is the elapsed time from start to finish?
R_text: Doorbhash par 48 minute ki dhvani ko saamanya raftaar ke 1.5 ke gunak par suna jaata hai. Beech mein 6 minute ki baatcheet se dhvani rukti hai, phir usi raftaar par chalti hai. Shuru se ant tak kitne minute beetenge?
C_text: Doorbhash par 48 minute ki dhvani is played at 1.5 times normal speed. Beech mein 6 minute ki baatcheet se rukti hai, phir usi raftaar par chalti hai. Shuru se ant tak kitne minute beetenge?

E_text: An event gate starts with 24 people waiting. Arrivals continue at 5 people per minute while admission proceeds at 8 people per minute. How many minutes until the queue first empties?
R_text: Samaroh ke pravesh par 24 log intezaar mein hain. Ek minute mein 5 aate hain aur 8 ko andar liya jaata hai. Pankti pehli baar khaali hone mein kitne minute lagenge?
C_text: Samaroh ke pravesh par 24 log intezaar mein hain. Arrivals are 5 people per minute and admissions are 8 per minute. Pankti pehli baar khaali hone mein kitne minute lagenge?

E_text: A hostel tank receives 9 L per minute and loses 2 L per minute through a leak. Its level rises from 20 L to 69 L. How long does this take?
R_text: Chhatravaas ki tanki mein ek minute mein 9 L aata aur daraar se 2 L beh jaata hai. Paani 20 L se 69 L ho jaata hai. Kitne minute lagte hain?
C_text: Chhatravaas ki tanki receives 9 L per minute and leaks 2 L per minute. Paani 20 L se 69 L hota hai. Kitne minute lagte hain?

E_text: An auto travels 12 km in 30 minutes, waits 10 minutes, then travels 8 km in 20 minutes. What is its average speed over the entire elapsed hour in kilometres per hour?
R_text: Tipahiya 30 minute mein 12 km chalta, 10 minute rukta aur phir 20 minute mein 8 km chalta hai. Is poore beete ghante mein ausat raftaar kitne km ek ghante mein hai?
C_text: Tipahiya 30 minute mein 12 km, phir 10 minute viraam, phir 20 minute mein 8 km chalta hai. What is its average speed over the entire elapsed hour in kilometres per hour?

E_text: Two office room bookings have the same duration and overlap for 15 minutes. The room is occupied for a total of 75 minutes across the two bookings, with no gap. How many minutes does each booking last?
R_text: Daftar ke kamre ki do aarakshanon ki avadhi samaan hai aur unke 15 minute ek saath padte hain. Donon aarakshan se kamra kul 75 minute tak ghira rehta hai, beech mein viraam nahin hai. Ek aarakshan ki avadhi kitne minute hai?
C_text: Daftar ke kamre ki do aarakshanon ki avadhi samaan hai aur unke 15 minute ek saath padte hain. Donon se kamra kul 75 minute tak ghira rehta hai, beech mein viraam nahin hai. How many minutes does each booking last?

E_text: A pond gauge displays three times the actual water depth in centimetres, minus 2. Its displayed number is 19. What is the actual depth in centimetres?
R_text: Taalaab ka maapak, cm mein asli gehraai ke 3 guna se 2 ghataakar sankhya dikhaata hai. Dikhne waali sankhya 19 hai. Asli gehraai kitne cm hai?
C_text: Taalaab ka maapak, cm mein asli gehraai ke 3 guna se 2 ghataakar sankhya dikhaata hai. Dikhne waali sankhya 19 hai. What is the actual depth in centimetres?

E_text: A phone stores a compressed file at one quarter of its original size, then attaches a fixed 6 MB header. The resulting file occupies 23 MB. How large was the original file in MB?
R_text: Doorbhaash par dabaayi gayi sanchika ka aakaar mool aakaar ka chautha hissa hai. Usmein 6 MB ki nishchit shirsh jaankaari lagne par aakaar 23 MB hota hai. Mool sanchika kitne MB ki thi?
C_text: Doorbhaash par the compressed file is one quarter of the original size, with a fixed 6 MB header added afterward. Isse aakaar 23 MB hota hai. Mool sanchika kitne MB ki thi?

E_text: A rectangular wedding canopy has a length 4 m greater than its width. Its perimeter is 56 m. What is its width in metres?
R_text: Shaadi ke aayataakaar shamiyane ki lambaai uski chaudaai se 4 m zyada hai. Uska parimaap 56 m hai. Chaudaai kitne m hai?
C_text: Shaadi ke aayataakaar shamiyane ki length is 4 m greater than its width. Uska parimaap 56 m hai. Chaudaai kitne m hai?

E_text: Three hostel meal accounts start with the same balance. Deductions of INR 6, INR 9 and INR 12 are made from the respective accounts. The balances afterward total INR 99. What was the starting balance of one account?
R_text: Chhatravaas ke bhojan ke teen khaaton mein shuru ki raashi samaan hai. Pehle se INR 6, doosre se INR 9 aur teesre se INR 12 kaat diye jaate hain. Iske baad teenon raashiyon ka yog INR 99 hai. Ek khaate mein shuru mein kitne rupaye the?
C_text: Chhatravaas ke bhojan ke teen khaaton mein shuru ki raashi samaan hai. INR 6, INR 9 and INR 12 are deducted from the respective accounts; their balances then total INR 99. Ek khaate mein shuru mein kitne rupaye the?

E_text: For a delivery of x kilometres, one auto service quotes INR (40 + 12*x), and another quotes INR (64 + 8*x). At what distance are the quotes equal?
R_text: x km ki pahunchaai par ek tipahiya seva ka bhaada INR (40 + 12*x) aur doosri ka INR (64 + 8*x) hai. Kitne km par donon bhaade baraabar honge?
C_text: x km ki pahunchaai par ek tipahiya seva ka bhaada INR (40 + 12*x) aur doosri ka INR (64 + 8*x) hai. At what distance in kilometres are the two quotes equal?

E_text: A clinic schedules four consultations of identical length, with a 5-minute gap between consecutive consultations. From the first start to the last finish takes 95 minutes. How long is one consultation?
R_text: Chikitsalay mein samaan avadhi ke chaar paraamarsh hain. Lagaatar do paraamarshon ke beech 5 minute ka viraam hai. Pehle ki shuruaat se antim ke ant tak 95 minute lagte hain. Ek paraamarsh kitne minute ka hai?
C_text: Chikitsalay mein samaan avadhi ke chaar paraamarsh hain. There is a 5-minute gap between consecutive consultations. Pehle ki shuruaat se antim ke ant tak 95 minute lagte hain. Ek paraamarsh kitne minute ka hai?

E_text: An office records the durations of three training sessions. Two lasted 12 minutes and 17 minutes. The arithmetic mean of all three durations is 15 minutes. How many minutes did the third session last?
R_text: Daftar mein teen prashikshan satron ki avadhi likhi gayi. Do satra 12 minute aur 17 minute chale. Teenon avadhiyon ka ankganitiya ausat 15 minute hai. Teesra satra kitne minute chala?
C_text: Daftar mein teen prashikshan satron mein se do 12 minute aur 17 minute chale. The arithmetic mean of all three durations is 15 minutes. Teesra satra kitne minute chala?

E_text: A nursery arranges 42 saplings in a rectangular grid. If there are x rows, there are x+1 saplings in a row. What is the positive whole-number value of x?
R_text: Paudhshaala mein 42 paudhe aayataakaar jaali mein lage hain. Panktiyon ki sankhya x ho to ek pankti mein x+1 paudhe hain. x ka dhan poornank maan kya hai?
C_text: Paudhshaala mein 42 paudhe aayataakaar jaali mein lage hain. If there are x rows, there are x+1 saplings in a row. x ka dhan poornank maan kya hai?

E_text: A library cabinet has a two-digit code ending in 3. Reversing its digits gives another two-digit code. Subtracting the reversed code from the original gives 27. What is the first digit of the original code?
R_text: Pustakalay ki almaari ki do ankon ki pehchaan sankhya ka antim ank 3 hai. Ankon ka kram palatne par bhi do ankon ki sankhya banti hai. Mool sankhya aur palti sankhya ka antar 27 hai, aur mool sankhya adhik hai. Mool sankhya ka pehla ank kya hai?
C_text: Pustakalay ki almaari ki do ankon ki pehchaan sankhya ka antim ank 3 hai. Ankon ka kram palatne par bhi do ankon ki sankhya banti hai. The original code minus the reversed code is 27. Mool sankhya ka pehla ank kya hai?

E_text: A phone has exactly 27 MB free. Identical clips each occupy a positive whole number of MB, with no storage overhead. Five clips fit, but six do not. How many MB does one clip occupy?
R_text: Doorbhaash mein theek 27 MB jagah khaali hai. Samaan aakaar ki chhoti chalchitra sanchikaaon mein ek sanchika dhan poornank MB leti hai; alag se koi jagah nahin lagti. Paanch sanchika samaati hain, chhah nahin. Ek sanchika kitne MB ki hai?
C_text: Doorbhaash mein theek 27 MB jagah khaali hai. Samaan aakaar ki ek chalchitra sanchika dhan poornank MB leti hai; alag se koi jagah nahin lagti. Five files fit, but six do not. Ek sanchika kitne MB ki hai?

E_text: A wedding rehearsal has its exact time midpoint at 14:35 and finishes at 15:10 on the same afternoon. How many minutes after 13:00 did it start?
R_text: Shaadi ke abhyaas ki shuruaat aur ant ke theek madhya ka samay 14:35 hai. Abhyaas usi dopahar 15:10 par khatm hota hai. Vah 13:00 se kitne minute baad shuru hua?
C_text: Shaadi ke abhyaas ka exact time midpoint is 14:35, and it finishes at 15:10 that afternoon. Vah 13:00 se kitne minute baad shuru hua?

E_text: A hostel sets out 48 L of drinking water for an initial group, with identical allocations. Four residents then join, and the same 48 L is reallocated identically across the enlarged group. The allocation drops by 2 L per person. How many residents were in the initial group?
R_text: Chhatravaas mein pehle samooh ke liye 48 L peene ka paani hai aur sabko samaan matra milni hai. Phir chaar nivaasi judte hain; usi 48 L se naye samooh mein sabko samaan matra milti hai. Ek vyakti ki matra mein 2 L ki giraavat aati hai. Pehle samooh mein kitne nivaasi the?
C_text: Chhatravaas mein pehle samooh ke liye 48 L paani hai aur sabko samaan matra milni hai. Chaar nivaasi judne par usi 48 L se naye samooh mein sabko samaan matra milti hai. The allocation drops by 2 L per person. Pehle samooh mein kitne nivaasi the?

E_text: A courier records three legs: half a reference distance x, one third of x, and a final 4 km. The complete journey is 19 km. What is x in kilometres?
R_text: Vaahak ki yaatra ke teen charan hain: sandarbh doori x ka aadha, x ka ek tihaai, aur antim 4 km. Poori yaatra 19 km hai. x kitne km hai?
C_text: Vaahak ki yaatra ke teen charan hain: sandarbh doori x ka aadha, x ka ek tihaai, aur antim 4 km. The complete journey is 19 km. x kitne km hai?

E_text: A school library had 245 storybooks. During reading week, 87 books were issued to students and 19 books were sent away for repair. How many storybooks are still on the library shelves?
R_text: Ek vidyalay ke pustakalay mein 245 kahani ki kitaabein thi. Padhai saptaah mein 87 kitaabein chhaatron ko di gayi aur 19 kitaabein marammat ke liye bheji gayi. Ab pustakalay ki almaariyon mein kitni kitaabein bachi hain?
C_text: Ek school library mein 245 storybooks thi. Reading week ke dauraan 87 books students ko di gayi, and 19 books were sent away for repair. Ab shelves par kitni kitaabein bachi hain?

E_text: In a cricket match, the Blue team scored 176 runs. The Green team scored 38 more runs than the Blue team. How many runs did the Green team score?
R_text: Ek cricket mukaable mein Neela dal ne 176 ran banaye. Hara dal ne Neela dal se 38 ran zyada banaye. Hara dal ne kitne ran banaye?
C_text: Ek cricket match mein Blue team ne 176 runs banaye. The Green team scored 38 more runs than the Blue team. Green team ne kitne runs banaye?

E_text: A bus has 52 seats. On Friday morning, 9 seats were empty. On Saturday morning, 5 fewer passengers were seated than on Friday morning. How many passengers were seated on Saturday morning?
R_text: Ek bus mein baithne ki 52 jagah hain. Shukravaar subah 9 jagah khaali thi. Shanivaar subah shukravaar subah se 5 yatri kam baithe the. Shanivaar subah kitne yatri baithe the?
C_text: Ek bus mein 52 seats hain. Shukravaar subah 9 seats khaali thi. On Saturday morning, 5 fewer passengers were seated than on Friday morning. Shanivaar subah kitne yatri baithe the?

E_text: Farmer Harpal harvested 1240 kg of wheat this year, which is 185 kg more than last year. Last year he sold 600 kg of his harvest and stored the rest in a godown. How many kilograms of wheat did he store last year?
R_text: Kisan Harpal ko is saal 1240 kg gehun ki paidaavaar mili, jo pichhle saal se 185 kg zyada hai. Pichhle saal usne 600 kg gehun beche aur baaki godaam mein rakh diya. Pichhle saal usne kitne kilo gehun godaam mein rakha?
C_text: Kisan Harpal ko is saal 1240 kg gehun mila, jo pichhle saal se 185 kg zyada hai. Last year he sold 600 kg, aur baaki godaam mein rakh diya. Pichhle saal usne kitne kg gehun godaam mein rakha?

E_text: A cricket team needs 260 runs to win. The two openers scored 94 runs, and the middle-order batters added 117 more runs. How many more runs does the team need to win?
R_text: Ek cricket dal ko jeetne ke liye 260 ran chahiye. Dono shuruaati ballebaazon ne 94 ran banaye, aur beech ke ballebaazon ne 117 ran aur banaye. Jeetne ke liye dal ko aur kitne ran chahiye?
C_text: Ek cricket team ko jeetne ke liye 260 runs chahiye. The two openers scored 94 runs, aur middle order ne 117 runs aur banaye. How many more runs does the team need to win?

E_text: A sweet shop prepared 18 kg of kheer. It sold 11.5 kg in the morning and 4.25 kg in the evening. How many kilograms of kheer were left?
R_text: Ek mithai ki dukaan ne 18 kg kheer banaayi. Subah 11.5 kg kheer biki aur shaam ko 4.25 kg. Kitne kilo kheer bachi?
C_text: Ek sweet shop ne 18 kg kheer banaayi. It sold 11.5 kg in the morning and 4.25 kg in the evening. Kitne kilo kheer bachi?

E_text: The rail route from Agra to Bhopal is 505 km long. A train has covered 178 km before lunch and 142 km after lunch. How many kilometres of the journey are still to be covered?
R_text: Agra se Bhopal tak rail ka raasta 505 km lamba hai. Railgaadi dopahar ke khaane se pehle 178 km aur uske baad 142 km chal chuki hai. Safar ke kitne kilometre abhi tay karne hain?
C_text: Agra se Bhopal tak rail route 505 km ka hai. Railgaadi lunch se pehle 178 km aur lunch ke baad 142 km chal chuki hai. How many kilometres of the journey are still to be covered?

E_text: Field A produced 860 kg of paddy. Field B produced 135 kg less paddy than Field A. How many kilograms of paddy did the two fields produce altogether?
R_text: Khet A mein 860 kg dhaan hua. Khet B mein khet A se 135 kg kam dhaan hua. Dono kheton mein kul kitne kilo dhaan hua?
C_text: Khet A mein 860 kg dhaan hua. Field B produced 135 kg less paddy than Field A. Dono kheton ka total production kitne kg hai?

E_text: For Holi, Arjun bought 750 g of green colour powder. He bought 250 g more pink powder than green powder, and 400 g less yellow powder than pink powder. How many grams of yellow powder did he buy?
R_text: Holi ke liye Arjun ne 750 g hara gulaal kharida. Usne hare gulaal se 250 g zyada gulaabi gulaal kharida, aur gulaabi gulaal se 400 g kam peela gulaal. Usne kitne gram peela gulaal kharida?
C_text: Holi ke liye Arjun ne 750 g hara gulaal kharida. Usne hare gulaal se 250 g zyada gulaabi gulaal liya, aur gulaabi se 400 g kam peela gulaal. How many grams of yellow gulaal did he buy?

E_text: A relay race is 4000 metres long and four runners run one after another. The first three runners covered 950 m, 1020 m and 980 m. How many metres must the last runner cover?
R_text: Ek lambi daud 4000 metre ki hai, jismein chaar dhaavak baari-baari se daudte hain. Pehle teen dhaavak 950 m, 1020 m aur 980 m daude. Aakhri dhaavak ko kitne metre daudna hoga?
C_text: Ek relay race 4000 metre ki hai, jismein chaar runners baari-baari se daudte hain. The first three runners covered 950 m, 1020 m and 980 m. Aakhri runner ko kitne metre daudna hoga?

E_text: A school ordered 500 notebooks for its annual exams. Class 6 received 135 notebooks, Class 7 received 142 and Class 8 received 158. How many notebooks have not yet been given to any class?
R_text: Ek vidyalay ne saalaana pariksha ke liye 500 kaapiyaan mangaayi. Kaksha 6 ko 135 kaapiyaan mili, kaksha 7 ko 142 aur kaksha 8 ko 158. Kitni kaapiyaan abhi tak kisi kaksha ko nahi di gayi?
C_text: Ek school ne annual exams ke liye 500 notebooks mangaayi. Kaksha 6 ko 135 notebooks mili, kaksha 7 ko 142 aur kaksha 8 ko 158. How many notebooks have not yet been given to any class?

E_text: A family of 5 bought train tickets costing ₹345 each. They paid with four ₹500 notes. How much change did they get back?
R_text: 5 logon ke ek parivaar ne railgaadi ke tikat kharide; har tikat 345 rupaye ka tha. Unhone 500 rupaye ke 4 note diye. Unhe kitne rupaye vaapas mile?
C_text: 5 logon ke ek parivaar ne railgaadi ke tikat kharide; har tikat 345 rupaye ka tha. They paid with four ₹500 notes. Unhe kitne rupaye vaapas mile?

E_text: A farmer sold 12 quintals of mustard at ₹5600 per quintal. He paid ₹1800 to transport it to the market. How much money did he have left after paying for transport?
R_text: Ek kisan ne 5600 rupaye prati kuntal ke bhaav se 12 kuntal sarson bechi. Mandi tak le jaane ke kiraaye mein usne 1800 rupaye diye. Kiraaya dene ke baad uske paas kitne rupaye rahe?
C_text: Ek kisan ne 12 kuntal sarson bechi at ₹5600 per quintal. Mandi tak transport ke liye usne ₹1800 pay kiye. Transport ke baad uske paas kitne rupaye rahe?

E_text: For Raksha Bandhan, Neha bought 6 rakhis at ₹45 each and a box of sweets for ₹320. She paid with a ₹1000 note. How much change did she receive?
R_text: Raksha Bandhan ke liye Neha ne 6 rakhiyaan kharidi, ek rakhi 45 rupaye ki thi, aur 320 rupaye ka mithai ka dibba liya. Usne dukaandaar ko 1000 rupaye ka note diya. Use kitne rupaye chhutte mile?
C_text: Raksha Bandhan ke liye Neha ne 6 rakhiyaan kharidi at ₹45 each, aur ₹320 ka mithai ka dibba liya. She paid with a ₹1000 note. Use kitne rupaye change mile?

E_text: A school bought 24 chairs at ₹850 each and 6 tables at ₹2400 each. What was the total cost?
R_text: Ek vidyalay ne 850 rupaye wali 24 kursiyaan aur 2400 rupaye wali 6 mezein kharidi. Kul kharch kitne rupaye hua?
C_text: Ek school ne ₹850 wali 24 kursiyaan aur ₹2400 wali 6 mezein kharidi. What was the total cost in rupees?

E_text: A bus ticket from Jaipur to Ajmer costs ₹160 for an adult and ₹90 for a child. Mr Sharma buys tickets for 2 adults and 3 children. How much does he pay?
R_text: Jaipur se Ajmer ka bus tikat ek vayask ke liye 160 rupaye aur ek bachche ke liye 90 rupaye ka hai. Sharma ji 2 vayaskon aur 3 bachchon ke tikat kharidte hain. Unhe kitne rupaye dene honge?
C_text: Jaipur se Ajmer ka bus ticket costs ₹160 for an adult and ₹90 for a child. Sharma ji 2 vayaskon aur 3 bachchon ke tikat kharidte hain. Unhe kitne rupaye dene honge?

E_text: Imran had ₹1500. He bought 4 kg of rice at ₹72 per kg and 2 litres of cooking oil at ₹165 per litre. How much money did he have left?
R_text: Imran ke paas 1500 rupaye the. Usne 72 rupaye kilo ke bhaav se 4 kg chaawal aur 165 rupaye litre ke bhaav se 2 litre tel kharida. Uske paas kitne rupaye bache?
C_text: Imran ke paas ₹1500 the. Usne 4 kg chaawal liya at ₹72 per kg, aur 2 litre tel at ₹165 per litre. How much money does he have left?

E_text: Ramesh hired 3 farm workers for 2 days, paying each worker ₹450 a day, and bought seeds worth ₹4200. He had set aside ₹10000 for these costs. How much of that amount is unspent?
R_text: Ramesh ne 2 din ke liye 3 khetihar mazdoor rakhe; ek mazdoor ko ek din ke 450 rupaye diye. Usne 4200 rupaye ke beej bhi kharide. In kharchon ke liye usne 10000 rupaye alag rakhe the. Us rakam mein se kitne rupaye kharch nahi hue?
C_text: Ramesh ne 2 din ke liye 3 farm workers rakhe, paying each worker ₹450 a day. Usne ₹4200 ke beej bhi kharide. In kharchon ke liye usne ₹10000 alag rakhe the. How much of that amount is unspent?

E_text: For a Navratri event, the organisers ordered 15 marigold garlands at ₹120 each and paid ₹2500 for lighting. How much did they spend in total?
R_text: Navratri ke aayojan ke liye aayojakon ne genda phoolon ki 15 maalaayein mangaayi, ek maala 120 rupaye ki, aur roshni ke liye 2500 rupaye diye. Kul kitne rupaye kharch hue?
C_text: Navratri event ke liye organisers ne 15 genda maalaayein order ki, ek maala 120 rupaye ki, and they paid ₹2500 for lighting. Kul kitne rupaye kharch hue?

E_text: A school trip costs ₹650 per student. A class of 38 students has collected ₹22000 so far. How much more money must the class collect?
R_text: Vidyalay ki ek yatra ka shulk prati chhaatra 650 rupaye hai. 38 chhaatron ki ek kaksha ne ab tak 22000 rupaye jama kiye hain. Kaksha ko aur kitne rupaye jama karne honge?
C_text: School trip ki fees ₹650 per student hai. 38 students ki ek kaksha ne ab tak ₹22000 collect kiye hain. Kaksha ko aur kitne rupaye collect karne honge?

E_text: A sports shop sells a cricket ball for ₹275 and a pair of batting gloves for ₹1150. A sports club buys 8 balls and 2 pairs of gloves. How much does the club pay?
R_text: Khel ke saamaan ki ek dukaan mein ek cricket gend 275 rupaye ki aur ballebaazi ke dastaanon ka ek joda 1150 rupaye ka milta hai. Ek khel samiti 8 gendein aur dastaanon ke 2 jode kharidti hai. Samiti kitne rupaye chukaati hai?
C_text: Ek sports shop mein cricket ball ₹275 ki aur batting gloves ka ek joda ₹1150 ka milta hai. A sports club buys 8 balls and 2 pairs of gloves. Club ko kitne rupaye dene honge?

E_text: A first-class train ticket costs ₹540 more than a second-class ticket. A second-class ticket costs ₹385. How much do 2 first-class tickets cost?
R_text: Railgaadi mein pehle darje ke tikat ka daam doosre darje ke tikat se 540 rupaye zyada hai. Doosre darje ka tikat 385 rupaye ka hai. Pehle darje ke 2 tikaton ka daam kitna hoga?
C_text: Train mein first class tikat ka daam second class tikat se 540 rupaye zyada hai. A second-class ticket costs ₹385. First class ke 2 tikaton ka daam kitna hoga?

E_text: Four friends ordered 3 thalis at ₹299 each and paid a ₹103 delivery charge. They split the bill equally. How much did each friend pay?
R_text: Chaar doston ne 299 rupaye wali 3 thaaliyaan mangaayi aur pahunchaane ke 103 rupaye diye. Unhone poora kharcha baraabar baant liya. Har dost ne kitne rupaye diye?
C_text: Chaar doston ne ₹299 wali 3 thaaliyaan order ki aur ₹103 delivery charge diya. They split the bill equally. Each friend ne kitne rupaye diye?

E_text: There are 640 students in a school, and 35% of them come by the school bus. How many students do not come by the school bus?
R_text: Ek vidyalay mein 640 chhaatra hain, aur unmein se 35% vidyalay ki bus se aate hain. Kitne chhaatra vidyalay ki bus se nahi aate?
C_text: Ek school mein 640 students hain, and 35% of them come by the school bus. Kitne students school bus se nahi aate?

E_text: A batter scored 80 runs in an innings, and 45% of those runs came from fours and sixes. How many of the batter's runs did not come from fours and sixes?
R_text: Ek ballebaaz ne ek pari mein 80 ran banaye. Inmein se 45 pratishat ran chaukon aur chhakkon se aaye. Uske kitne ran chaukon aur chhakkon se nahi aaye?
C_text: Ek ballebaaz ne ek pari mein 80 ran banaye. Inmein se 45 pratishat ran chaukon aur chhakkon se aaye. How many of his runs did not come from fours and sixes?

E_text: A shop gives a 20% discount on a Diwali lantern marked at ₹450. Seema buys 3 lanterns. How much does she pay?
R_text: Ek dukaan Diwali ki kandeel par, jiska likha hua daam 450 rupaye hai, 20% chhoot de rahi hai. Seema 3 kandeel kharidti hai. Use kitne rupaye dene honge?
C_text: Ek dukaan Diwali kandeel par, jiska marked price ₹450 hai, 20% discount de rahi hai. Seema buys 3 lanterns. Use kitne rupaye dene honge?

E_text: A school has 480 students, and each student chose exactly one hobby club. 3/8 of them chose dance, 1/4 chose music and the rest chose art. How many students chose art?
R_text: Ek vidyalay mein 480 chhaatra hain, aur har chhaatra ne theek ek shauk-samooh chuna. Unmein se 3/8 ne nritya chuna, 1/4 ne sangeet, aur baaki ne chitrakala. Kitne chhaatron ne chitrakala chuni?
C_text: Ek school mein 480 students hain, and each student chose exactly one hobby club. Unmein se 3/8 ne dance chuna, 1/4 ne music, and the rest chose art. Kitne students ne art chuna?

E_text: A 1.5-litre bottle of mango juice is opened. 2/5 of the juice is served at lunch and 0.4 litres at dinner. How many litres of juice are still in the bottle?
R_text: Aam ke ras ki 1.5 litre ki ek botal kholi gayi. Dopahar ke khaane mein ras ka 2/5 parosa gaya aur raat ke khaane mein 0.4 litre. Botal mein abhi kitne litre ras hai?
C_text: Aam ke juice ki 1.5 litre ki ek botal kholi gayi. At lunch, 2/5 of the juice was served, aur raat ke khaane mein 0.4 litre. Botal mein abhi kitne litre juice hai?

E_text: A bus fare of ₹240 is increased by 15%. What is the new fare for 2 passengers?
R_text: Ek bus ka kiraaya 240 rupaye hai. Is kiraaye mein 15% ki badhottari ki gayi. Naye kiraaye se 2 yatriyon ka kiraaya kitna hoga?
C_text: Ek bus ka kiraaya ₹240 hai. The fare was increased by 15%. Naye kiraaye se 2 passengers ka kiraaya kitna hoga?

E_text: A farmer owns 60 acres of land. Wheat is grown on 45% of it and sugarcane on 1/3 of it. On how many acres is neither crop grown?
R_text: Ek kisan ke paas 60 ekad zameen hai. Iske 45 pratishat par gehun aur 1/3 par ganna boya gaya hai. Kitne ekad zameen par in dono mein se koi fasal nahi boyi gayi?
C_text: Ek kisan ke paas 60 acre zameen hai. Wheat is grown on 45 percent of it, aur 1/3 par ganna boya gaya hai. Kitne acre zameen par neither crop is grown?

E_text: For a Holi party, 2.4 kg of gujiya were made. One-sixth of them were given to the neighbours and three-eighths of them were eaten at the party. How many kilograms of gujiya were left?
R_text: Holi ke utsav ke liye 2.4 kg gujiya banaayi gayi. Inka ek-chhatha hissa padosiyon ko diya gaya aur teen-aathvaan hissa utsav mein khaaya gaya. Kitne kilo gujiya bachi?
C_text: For the Holi party, 2.4 kg gujiya were made. Inka ek-chhatha hissa padosiyon ko diya gaya aur teen-aathvaan hissa party mein khaaya gaya. Kitne kilo gujiya bachi?

E_text: Out of 36 questions in a test, Tanya answered 27 correctly. What fraction of the questions did she answer correctly? Give the answer in simplest form.
R_text: Ek pariksha ke 36 prashnon mein se Tanya ne 27 prashn sahi kiye. Tanya ke sahi uttar kul prashnon ka kaunsa bhinn hain? Uttar sabse saral roop mein dein.
C_text: Ek test ke 36 prashnon mein se Tanya answered 27 correctly. Uske sahi uttar kul prashnon ka kaunsa bhinn hain? Give the answer in simplest form.

E_text: In a lemonade recipe, sugar syrup and lemon juice are mixed in the ratio 5:2. If 350 ml of sugar syrup is used, how many millilitres of lemon juice are needed?
R_text: Shikanji banaane ke liye chaashni aur neembu ka ras 5:2 ke anupaat mein milaaye jaate hain. Agar 350 ml chaashni li jaaye, to kitne ml neembu ka ras chahiye?
C_text: Shikanji ke liye chaashni aur neembu ka ras 5:2 ke anupaat mein milaaye jaate hain. If 350 ml of syrup is used, kitne ml neembu ka ras chahiye?

E_text: A class has boys and girls in the ratio 5:7. There are 20 boys. How many students are in the class?
R_text: Ek kaksha mein ladkon aur ladkiyon ki sankhya 5:7 mein hai. Kaksha mein 20 ladke hain. Kaksha mein kitne chhaatra hain?
C_text: Ek kaksha mein ladkon aur ladkiyon ki sankhya 5:7 mein hai. There are 20 boys in the class. Kaksha mein total kitne students hain?

E_text: On a train, the numbers of passengers in sleeper class and general class are in the ratio 7:9. There are 288 passengers in general class. How many passengers are in sleeper class?
R_text: Ek railgaadi mein shayika shreni aur saamaanya shreni ke yatriyon ki sankhya 7:9 mein hai. Saamaanya shreni mein 288 yatri hain. Shayika shreni mein kitne yatri hain?
C_text: Ek train mein sleeper class aur general class ke yatriyon ki sankhya 7:9 mein hai. General class mein 288 yatri hain. How many passengers are in sleeper class?

E_text: A cook mixes rice and lentils in the ratio 3:1 by weight to make khichdi. How many grams of rice are needed to make 2 kg of the mixture?
R_text: Ek rasoiya khichdi ke liye chaawal aur daal ko vazan ke hisaab se 3:1 mein milaata hai. 2 kg mishran banaane ke liye kitne gram chaawal chahiye?
C_text: Ek rasoiya khichdi ke liye chaawal aur daal ko weight ke hisaab se 3:1 mein mix karta hai. To make 2 kg of the mixture, kitne gram chaawal chahiye?

E_text: A fertiliser mix contains urea and potash in the ratio 5:3 by weight. A farmer has 24 kg of potash and wants to use all of it. How many kilograms of the mix can he make?
R_text: Ek khaad ke mishran mein yuriya aur potaash vazan ke hisaab se 5:3 mein hote hain. Ek kisan ke paas 24 kg potaash hai aur vah saara potaash istemaal karna chahta hai. Vah kitne kilo mishran bana sakta hai?
C_text: Ek khaad mix mein urea aur potash weight ke hisaab se 5:3 mein hote hain. Ek kisan ke paas 24 kg potash hai, and he wants to use all of it. Vah kitne kg mix bana sakta hai?

E_text: A tea stall uses 120 ml of milk for one cup of tea. How many litres of milk are needed for 75 cups?
R_text: Ek chaay ki dukaan ek pyaale chaay mein 120 ml doodh daalti hai. 75 pyaale chaay ke liye kitne litre doodh chahiye?
C_text: Ek tea stall ek cup chaay mein 120 ml doodh daalta hai. How many litres of milk are needed for 75 cups?

E_text: A tubewell fills a field tank at 450 litres per minute. The tank holds 27000 litres. How many minutes does it take to fill the empty tank?
R_text: Ek nalkoop 450 litre prati minute ki dar se khet ki tanki bharta hai. Tanki mein 27000 litre paani aata hai. Khaali tanki bharne mein kitne minute lagenge?
C_text: Ek nalkoop 450 litre prati minute ki dar se khet ki tanki bharta hai. The tank holds 27000 litres. Khaali tanki bharne mein kitne minute lagenge?

E_text: A cyclist rides at 18 km/h for 2.5 hours and then at 12 km/h for 1.5 hours. How many kilometres does she ride?
