R_text: Ek cycle chaalak 18 km/h ki raftaar se 2.5 ghante aur phir 12 km/h ki raftaar se 1.5 ghante cycle chalaati hai. Usne kitne kilometre cycle chalaayi?
C_text: Ek cyclist 2.5 ghante 18 km/h ki raftaar se cycle chalaati hai, and then she rides at 12 km/h for 1.5 hours. Usne kitne kilometre cycle chalaayi?

E_text: A school printer prints 24 pages in a minute. How many minutes will it take to print 30 copies of a 16-page question paper?
R_text: Vidyalay ki chhapaai machine ek minute mein 24 panne chhaapti hai. 16 panne wale prashn-patra ki 30 pratiyaan chhaapne mein kitne minute lagenge?
C_text: School ka printer ek minute mein 24 pages print karta hai. 16 page wale question paper ki 30 copies print karne mein how many minutes will it take?

E_text: During Ganesh Chaturthi, a sweet maker makes 36 modaks every hour. He works 7 hours a day for 3 days. How many modaks does he make?
R_text: Ganesh Chaturthi ke dauraan ek halwaai har ghante 36 modak banaata hai. Vah roz 7 ghante, 3 din tak kaam karta hai. Vah kitne modak banaata hai?
C_text: Ganesh Chaturthi ke dauraan ek halwaai makes 36 modaks every hour. Vah roz 7 ghante, 3 din tak kaam karta hai. Vah kitne modak banaata hai?

E_text: A bus leaves its stand at 6:40 a.m. and reaches the city at 9:10 a.m. The route is 95 km long. What is its average speed in km per hour?
R_text: Ek bus subah 6:40 baje adde se chalti hai aur subah 9:10 baje shahar pahunchti hai. Raasta 95 km lamba hai. Uski ausat raftaar kitne km/h hai?
C_text: Ek bus subah 6:40 baje adde se chalti hai and reaches the city at 9:10 a.m. Raasta 95 km lamba hai. What is its average speed in km per hour?

E_text: A canteen makes 4 rotis from every 100 g of flour. How many kilograms of flour are needed for 340 rotis?
R_text: Ek bhojanaalay har 100 g aate se 4 rotiyaan banaata hai. 340 rotiyon ke liye kitne kilo aata chahiye?
C_text: Ek bhojanaalay har 100 g aate se 4 rotiyaan banaata hai. How many kilograms of flour are needed for 340 rotis?

E_text: A pair of oxen ploughs 0.25 acre of a field in an hour. How many hours will they take to plough a 3-acre field?
R_text: Bailon ki ek jodi ek ghante mein 0.25 ekad khet jotti hai. 3 ekad ka khet jotne mein unhe kitne ghante lagenge?
C_text: Bailon ki ek jodi ek ghante mein 0.25 acre khet jotti hai. How many hours will they take to plough a 3-acre field?

E_text: A passenger train stops for 2 minutes at each of 9 halts on its route and is moving for 72 minutes. How many hours does the whole journey take?
R_text: Ek savaari railgaadi apne raaste mein 9 padaavon par 2-2 minute rukti hai, aur 72 minute chalti hai. Poori yatra mein kitne ghante lagte hain?
C_text: Ek passenger train apne raaste mein 9 padaavon par 2-2 minute rukti hai, and it is moving for 72 minutes. Poori yatra mein kitne ghante lagte hain?

E_text: At a Diwali feast, each of 3 cooks fries 120 puris an hour. How many puris do the 3 cooks fry in 2.5 hours?
R_text: Diwali ki daawat mein 3 rasoiye hain, aur ek rasoiya ek ghante mein 120 puriyaan talta hai. 2.5 ghante mein teenon rasoiye kitni puriyaan talenge?
C_text: Diwali ki daawat mein 3 rasoiye hain, and each cook fries 120 puris an hour. 2.5 ghante mein teenon rasoiye kitni puriyaan talenge?

E_text: A student thought of a number, multiplied it by 4 and then added 9, getting 61. What was the number?
R_text: Ek chhaatra ne ek sankhya sochi, use 4 se guna kiya aur phir usmein 9 joda, to 61 mila. Sankhya kya thi?
C_text: A student thought of a number. Usne use 4 se guna kiya aur phir usmein 9 joda, to 61 mila. Sankhya kya thi?

E_text: In two innings, Sana scored x runs and then 2x + 5 runs. She scored 77 runs in the two innings. How many runs did she score in the second innings?
R_text: Do pariyon mein Sana ne pehle x ran aur phir 2x + 5 ran banaye. Do pariyon mein usne 77 ran banaye. Doosri pari mein usne kitne ran banaye?
C_text: Do innings mein Sana scored x runs and then 2x + 5 runs. Do innings mein usne 77 runs banaye. Doosri innings mein usne kitne runs banaye?

E_text: A cook has some potatoes. If she had 3 times as many and then 8 more, she would have 50 potatoes. How many potatoes does she have?
R_text: Ek rasoiye ke paas kuch aalu hain. Agar uske paas inke 3 guna se 8 zyada aalu hote, to 50 aalu hote. Uske paas kitne aalu hain?
C_text: Ek rasoiye ke paas kuch aalu hain. If she had three times as many and then 8 more, she would have 50. Uske paas kitne aalu hain?

E_text: A transport company has 9 buses. Some have 40 seats and the others have 52 seats. The 9 buses have 396 seats. How many buses have 52 seats?
R_text: Ek parivahan sanstha ke paas 9 bus hain. Kuch bus mein baithne ki 40 jagah hain aur doosri bus mein 52 jagah. In 9 bus mein baithne ki 396 jagah hain. 52 jagah wali kitni bus hain?
C_text: Ek transport company ke paas 9 bus hain. Some buses have 40 seats and the others have 52 seats. In 9 bus mein 396 seats hain. 52 seats wali kitni bus hain?

E_text: A farmer has goats and hens. He has 12 fewer goats than hens. The animals have 120 legs altogether. How many goats does he have?
R_text: Ek kisan ke paas bakriyaan aur murgiyaan hain. Bakriyaan murgiyon se 12 kam hain. Sab jaanvaron ki taangein ginne par 120 hoti hain. Kisan ke paas kitni bakriyaan hain?
C_text: Ek kisan ke paas bakriyaan aur murgiyaan hain. Bakriyaan murgiyon se 12 kam hain. All the animals together have 120 legs. Kisan ke paas kitni bakriyaan hain?

E_text: On Diwali, Anil bought 25 clay lamps at ₹d each and a matchbox with wicks for ₹15. He spent ₹190. What is the value of d?
R_text: Diwali par Anil ne 25 diye kharide, ek diya d rupaye ka, aur 15 rupaye ki maachis aur battiyaan li. Usne 190 rupaye kharch kiye. d ka maan kya hai?
C_text: Diwali par Anil ne 25 diye kharide, ek diya d rupaye ka, aur ₹15 ki maachis aur battiyaan li. He spent ₹190. Find the value of d.

E_text: Two classes have the same number of students. If 6 students move from Class A to Class B, Class B will have twice as many students as Class A. How many students are in each class now?
R_text: Do kakshaon mein chhaatron ki sankhya baraabar hai. Agar kaksha A se 6 chhaatra kaksha B mein chale jaayen, to kaksha B mein kaksha A ke 2 guna chhaatra ho jaayenge. Abhi har kaksha mein kitne chhaatra hain?
C_text: Do kakshaon mein the same number of students hain. Agar kaksha A se 6 chhaatra kaksha B mein chale jaayen, then Class B will have twice as many students as Class A. Abhi each class mein kitne chhaatra hain?

E_text: A hockey team scored x goals in each of its first 5 matches and 3 goals in its sixth match. It scored 23 goals in the 6 matches. What is x?
R_text: Ek hockey dal ne apne pehle 5 mukaablon mein x-x gol kiye aur chhathe mukaable mein 3 gol. 6 mukaablon mein usne 23 gol kiye. x ka maan kya hai?
C_text: Ek hockey team scored x goals in each of its first 5 matches, aur chhathe mukaable mein 3 gol. 6 mukaablon mein usne 23 gol kiye. x ka maan kya hai?

E_text: A cup of tea costs ₹10. Three samosas and two cups of tea cost ₹80. What is the price of one samosa?
R_text: Ek pyaala chaay 10 rupaye ki hai. 3 samose aur 2 pyaale chaay 80 rupaye ke hain. Ek samosa kitne rupaye ka hai?
C_text: Ek cup chaay 10 rupaye ki hai. Three samosas and two cups of tea cost ₹80. Ek samosa kitne rupaye ka hai?

E_text: By bus, village Q is 35 km farther from the city than village P. The two bus distances add up to 145 km. How far is village P from the city by bus?
R_text: Bus ke raaste se, shahar se Q gaon ki doori P gaon ki doori se 35 km zyada hai. Dono dooriyon ka jod 145 km hai. Bus ke raaste se shahar se P gaon kitne km door hai?
C_text: Bus ke raaste se, shahar se Q gaon ki doori P gaon ki doori se 35 km zyada hai. Dono dooriyon ka jod 145 km hai. How far is village P from the city by bus?

E_text: A farmer planted mango trees and lemon trees. He planted 4 times as many lemon trees as mango trees, and 85 trees in all. How many lemon trees did he plant?
R_text: Ek kisan ne aam aur neembu ke ped lagaaye. Usne aam ke pedon ke 4 guna neembu ke ped lagaaye, aur kul 85 ped lagaaye. Usne neembu ke kitne ped lagaaye?
C_text: Ek kisan ne aam aur neembu ke ped lagaaye. He planted four times as many lemon trees as mango trees, aur total 85 ped lagaaye. Usne neembu ke kitne ped lagaaye?

E_text: At a vegetable stall, a sack of onions weighs 7.5 kg. A sack of potatoes weighs 2.75 kg less than the sack of onions. What is the combined weight of the two sacks?
R_text: Ek sabzi ki dukaan par pyaaz ke bore ka vazan 7.5 kg hai. Aaloo ke bore ka vazan pyaaz ke bore se 2.75 kg kam hai. Dono boron ka milaakar vazan kitna hai?
C_text: Ek sabzi ki dukaan par pyaaz ke bore ka vazan 7.5 kg hai. Aaloo ke bore ka vazan pyaaz ke bore se 2.75 kg kam hai. What is the combined weight of both sacks?

E_text: A mason laid 340 bricks on Monday. On Tuesday he laid 85 more bricks than on Monday. How many bricks did he lay on Tuesday?
R_text: Ek raajmistri ne somvaar ko 340 eentein lagaayi. Mangalvaar ko usne somvaar se 85 eentein zyada lagaayi. Mangalvaar ko usne kitni eentein lagaayi?
C_text: Ek raajmistri ne somvaar ko 340 eentein lagaayi. On Tuesday he laid 85 more bricks than on Monday. Mangalvaar ko usne kitni eentein lagaayi?

E_text: Priya's car has a fuel tank that holds 45 litres. She filled the tank to the top and then used 28 litres of fuel on a trip. How many litres of fuel are in the tank now?
R_text: Priya ki gaadi ki tanki mein 45 litre tel aata hai. Usne tanki ko oopar tak bharwaaya aur phir ek safar mein 28 litre tel kharch kiya. Ab tanki mein kitne litre tel hai?
C_text: Priya ki gaadi ki tanki mein 45 litre tel aata hai. She filled the tank to the top and then used 28 litres on a trip. Ab tanki mein kitne litre tel hai?

E_text: Anil had 5,200 rupees in his savings account. He withdrew 1,750 rupees for his study expenses and then deposited 900 rupees. How much money is in the account now?
R_text: Anil ke bachat khaate mein 5200 rupaye the. Usne padhaai ke kharche ke liye 1750 rupaye nikaale aur phir 900 rupaye jama kiye. Ab khaate mein kitne rupaye hain?
C_text: Anil ke bachat khaate mein 5200 rupaye the. Usne padhaai ke kharche ke liye 1750 rupaye nikaale, and then he deposited 900 rupees. What is the balance in the account now?

E_text: A tailor had a 25-metre roll of cloth. He made 6 kurtas, using 3.5 metres of cloth for each kurta. How many metres of cloth were left?
R_text: Ek darzi ke paas 25 metre kapde ka thaan tha. Usne 6 kurte banaaye aur har kurte mein 3.5 metre kapda laga. Kitne metre kapda bacha?
C_text: Ek darzi ke paas 25 metre kapde ka thaan tha. Usne 6 kurte banaaye, using 3.5 metres of cloth for each kurta. How many metres of cloth were left over?

E_text: Going from Agra to Jaipur by bus takes 4.5 hours. Going by train takes 1.25 hours more than going by bus. How many hours does the train journey take?
R_text: Agra se Jaipur tak bus se jaane mein 4.5 ghante lagte hain. Railgaadi se jaane mein bus se 1.25 ghante zyada lagte hain. Railgaadi se jaane mein kitne ghante lagte hain?
C_text: Agra se Jaipur tak bus se jaane mein 4.5 ghante lagte hain. Railgaadi se jaane mein bus se 1.25 ghante zyada lagte hain. How many hours does the train journey take?

E_text: A shopkeeper had 120 notebooks. He sold 47 notebooks in the morning and 38 in the evening. How many notebooks does he have now?
R_text: Ek dukaandaar ke paas 120 copiyaan thi. Usne subah 47 copiyaan aur shaam ko 38 copiyaan bechi. Ab uske paas kitni copiyaan hain?
C_text: Ek dukaandaar ke paas 120 copiyaan thi. He sold 47 notebooks in the morning and 38 in the evening. Ab uske paas kitni copiyaan hain?

E_text: Painting the living room costs 3,600 rupees. Painting the bedroom costs 1,150 rupees less than painting the living room. What is the total cost of painting both rooms?
R_text: Baithak ki putaai ka kharcha 3600 rupaye hai. Sone ke kamre ki putaai ka kharcha baithak se 1150 rupaye kam hai. Dono kamron ki putaai par kitne rupaye kharch honge?
C_text: Baithak ki putaai ka kharcha 3600 rupaye hai. Sone ke kamre ki putaai ka kharcha baithak se 1150 rupaye kam hai. Find the total cost of painting both rooms.

E_text: Kavya had 500 rupees. She bought a bag for 275 rupees and a pencil box for 95 rupees. How much money does she have now?
R_text: Kavya ke paas 500 rupaye the. Usne 275 rupaye ka ek thaila aur 95 rupaye ka ek pensil ka dabba khareeda. Ab uske paas kitne rupaye hain?
C_text: Kavya ke paas 500 rupaye the. She bought a bag for 275 rupees and a pencil box for 95 rupees. Ab uske paas kitne rupaye hain?

E_text: A tailor takes 75 minutes to stitch a shirt. Stitching a pair of pyjamas takes 20 minutes less than stitching a shirt. How many minutes does he need to stitch one shirt and one pair of pyjamas?
R_text: Ek darzi ko ek kameez silne mein 75 minute lagte hain. Ek pajaama silne mein kameez se 20 minute kam lagte hain. Ek kameez aur ek pajaama silne mein use kitne minute lagenge?
C_text: Ek darzi ko ek kameez silne mein 75 minute lagte hain. A pair of pyjamas takes 20 minutes less than a shirt. Ek kameez aur ek pajaama silne mein use kitne minute lagenge?

E_text: Arjun's journey is 260 km long. He has already driven 185 km. How many more kilometres does he have to drive?
R_text: Arjun ka safar 260 km lamba hai. Woh ab tak 185 km gaadi chala chuka hai. Use aur kitne kilometre gaadi chalaani hai?
C_text: Arjun ka safar 260 km lamba hai. He has already driven 185 km. How many more kilometres does he have to drive?

E_text: Seema bought 3 kg of mangoes at 60 rupees per kg. She gave the shopkeeper 200 rupees. How much change did she get back?
R_text: Seema ne 60 rupaye prati kilo ke bhaav se 3 kilo aam khareede. Usne dukaandaar ko 200 rupaye diye. Use kitne rupaye vaapas mile?
C_text: Seema ne 60 rupaye prati kilo ke bhaav se 3 kilo aam khareede. She gave the shopkeeper 200 rupees. Use kitne rupaye vaapas mile?

E_text: A plumber charges 350 rupees for each tap he fits, plus a separate visiting charge of 200 rupees. He fits 4 taps in a house. What is the total amount to be paid?
R_text: Ek nalsaaz har nal lagaane ke 350 rupaye leta hai, aur aane ke 200 rupaye alag se leta hai. Usne ek ghar mein 4 nal lagaaye. Use kul kitne rupaye dene honge?
C_text: Ek nalsaaz charges 350 rupees for each tap he fits, aur aane ke 200 rupaye alag se leta hai. Usne ek ghar mein 4 nal lagaaye. What is the total amount to be paid?

E_text: Rohan put 12 litres of fuel in his car. One litre cost 104 rupees. He also paid 50 rupees to get the car washed. How much did he pay altogether?
R_text: Rohan ne apni gaadi mein 12 litre tel daalwaaya. Ek litre tel 104 rupaye ka tha. Usne gaadi ki dhulaai ke 50 rupaye bhi diye. Usne kitne rupaye chukaaye?
C_text: Rohan ne apni gaadi mein 12 litre tel daalwaaya. One litre cost 104 rupees. Usne gaadi ki dhulaai ke 50 rupaye bhi diye. How much did he pay altogether?

E_text: Sunita deposited 8,000 rupees in a post office savings scheme. After one year she received 6 rupees of interest for every 100 rupees deposited. How much money did she have at the end of the year?
R_text: Sunita ne daakghar ki bachat yojana mein 8000 rupaye jama kiye. Ek saal baad use har 100 rupaye par 6 rupaye byaaj mila. Saal ke ant mein uske paas kitne rupaye the?
C_text: Sunita ne daakghar ki bachat yojana mein 8000 rupaye jama kiye. Ek saal baad use har 100 rupaye par 6 rupaye byaaj mila. How much money did she have at the end of the year?

C_text: Lalit ne mitti ke 15 gamle khareede. Each pot cost 40 rupees. Usne 260 rupaye ki khaad ki ek bori bhi khareedi. How much did he spend in all?

E_text: Three friends had matching kurtas stitched by a tailor. The cloth cost 1,350 rupees and the stitching cost 750 rupees. They split the total cost equally. How much did each friend pay?
R_text: Teen doston ne ek darzi se ek jaise kurte silwaaye. Kapde ke 1350 rupaye aur silaai ke 750 rupaye lage. Unhone poora kharcha aapas mein baraabar baanta. Har dost ne kitne rupaye diye?
C_text: Teen doston ne ek darzi se matching kurte silwaaye. Kapde ke 1350 rupaye aur silaai ke 750 rupaye lage. They split the total cost equally. How much did each friend pay?

C_text: 6 pensilon ka ek dabba 54 rupaye ka aata hai. Asha buys 4 boxes and one eraser that costs 8 rupees. Woh kitne rupaye deti hai?

R_text: Ek thekedaar ne ek mazdoor ko 6 din tak 650 rupaye roz dene ki baat ki. Ek din der se aane ki vajah se uski mazdoori se 150 rupaye kaat liye gaye. Mazdoor ko kitne rupaye mile?

E_text: On a bus, an adult ticket costs 85 rupees and a child ticket costs 45 rupees. A family of 2 adults and 3 children travels by this bus. How much do their tickets cost?
R_text: Bus mein ek vayask ka tikat 85 rupaye aur ek bachche ka tikat 45 rupaye hai. 2 vayask aur 3 bachchon wala ek parivaar is bus se safar karta hai. Unke tikaton par kitne rupaye kharch honge?

E_text: At a plant nursery, a tulsi sapling costs 30 rupees and a neem sapling costs 55 rupees. A school bought 10 tulsi saplings and 6 neem saplings. How much did the school pay?
R_text: Ek paudhshaala mein tulsi ka paudha 30 rupaye aur neem ka paudha 55 rupaye mein milta hai. Ek vidyaalay ne tulsi ke 10 aur neem ke 6 paudhe khareede. Vidyaalay ne kitne rupaye diye?

E_text: At a fair, a toy car costs 120 rupees and a doll costs 45 rupees more than the toy car. Neha buys one toy car and one doll. How much does she spend?
R_text: Mele mein ek khilauna gaadi 120 rupaye ki hai aur ek gudiya khilauna gaadi se 45 rupaye zyada ki hai. Neha ek khilauna gaadi aur ek gudiya khareedti hai. Woh kitne rupaye kharch karti hai?
C_text: Mele mein ek khilauna gaadi 120 rupaye ki hai, and a doll costs 45 rupees more than the toy car. Neha ek khilauna gaadi aur ek gudiya khareedti hai. Woh kitne rupaye kharch karti hai?

E_text: Ramesh needs 150 bricks for a wall. One brick costs 9 rupees, and the labour charge is 600 rupees. How much will he spend in all?

C_text: Ramesh ko ek deewar ke liye 150 eentein chahiye. One brick costs 9 rupees, and the labour charge is 600 rupees. Ramesh ko kitne rupaye kharch karne honge?

E_text: A saree is priced at 2,400 rupees. The shopkeeper gives a 15 percent discount on it. For how many rupees will the saree be sold?

E_text: Pooja's monthly income is 24,000 rupees. She saves 1/6 of her income every month. How much does she save in one year?

E_text: A shop had 80 kg of rice. On Monday the shop sold 3/8 of the rice. How many kilograms of rice were sold on Monday?

C_text: Ek dukaan mein 80 kg chaawal tha. On Monday the shop sold 3/8 of the rice. Somvaar ko kitne kilo chaawal bika?

E_text: Mohan received a reward of 9,000 rupees. He put two-fifths of it in a fixed deposit and gave one-third of the remaining amount to his sister. How much did his sister get?
R_text: Mohan ko 9000 rupaye ka inaam mila. Usne iska do-paanchvaan hissa saavadhi jama mein daala aur baaki rakam ka ek-tihaai hissa apni behen ko diya. Behen ko kitne rupaye mile?
C_text: Mohan ko 9000 rupaye ka inaam mila. Usne iska do-paanchvaan hissa fixed deposit mein daala aur baaki rakam ka ek-tihaai hissa apni behen ko diya. How much money did his sister get?

E_text: 250 seeds were sown in a garden. 84 percent of the seeds sprouted. How many seeds did not sprout?
R_text: Bageeche mein 250 beej boye gaye. Inmein se 84 pratishat beej ankurit hue. Kitne beej ankurit nahin hue?
C_text: Bageeche mein 250 beej boye gaye. 84 percent of the seeds sprouted. How many seeds did not sprout?

E_text: A family is making a 360 km trip. On the first day they covered 5/9 of the distance. How many kilometres did they cover on the first day?

E_text: A shopkeeper mixes two kinds of tea leaves in the ratio 3 : 2 by weight. How many kilograms of the first kind are in 15 kg of the mixture?

R_text: Ek safar mein Aman ne 120 km aur Vikas ne 80 km gaadi chalaayi. Tel ka 1500 rupaye ka kharcha unhone apni-apni chalaayi doori ke hisaab se aapas mein diya. Aman ne kitne rupaye diye?
C_text: Ek safar mein Aman ne 120 km aur Vikas ne 80 km gaadi chalaayi. They split the fuel cost of 1500 rupees in proportion to the distance each of them drove. Aman ne kitne rupaye diye?

E_text: Grandfather had saved 12,000 rupees for his two grandsons. He divided the money between them in the ratio 5 : 7. How much more did the second grandson get than the first?
R_text: Dadaji ne apne do poton ke liye 12000 rupaye jodkar rakhe the. Unhone ye rupaye 5 : 7 ke anupaat mein baante. Doosre pote ko pehle pote se kitne rupaye zyada mile?
C_text: Dadaji had saved 12000 rupees for his two grandsons. Unhone ye rupaye 5 : 7 ke anupaat mein baante. Doosre pote ko pehle pote se kitne rupaye zyada mile?

E_text: A shop sold cartons of mango juice and orange juice in the ratio 5 : 3. It sold 40 cartons of mango juice. How many cartons of orange juice did it sell?
R_text: Ek dukaan ne aam ke ras aur santare ke ras ke dabbe 5 : 3 mein beche. Aam ke ras ke 40 dabbe bike. Santare ke ras ke kitne dabbe bike?
C_text: Ek dukaan ne aam ke ras aur santare ke ras ke dabbe 5 : 3 mein beche. It sold 40 cartons of mango juice. Santare ke ras ke kitne dabbe bike?

E_text: The length and width of a rectangular room are in the ratio 3 : 2. The width of the room is 4 metres. What is the perimeter of the room?

R_text: Ek dukaandaar ke liye lohe ki ek kadhaai ka khareed mulya aur bikri mulya 5 : 6 mein hain. Khareed mulya 1500 rupaye hai. Ek kadhaai bechne par use kitna munaafa hota hai?

C_text: Sanjay apni cycle ek sthir gati se chalaata hai and covers 15 km in one hour. 9 km tay karne mein use kitne minute lagenge?

C_text: Ek bus makes 4 one-way trips a day between two towns. Ek taraf ka safar 38 km ka hai. 5 din mein bus kitne kilometre chalti hai?

E_text: Kamla buys some potatoes at 25 rupees per kg and one bunch of coriander for 30 rupees. She pays 205 rupees in total. How many kilograms of potatoes did she buy?
R_text: Kamla 25 rupaye prati kilo ke bhaav se kuchh aaloo aur 30 rupaye ki ek gaddi dhaniya khareedti hai. Woh kul 205 rupaye deti hai. Usne kitne kilo aaloo khareede?
